name: Jon Ossoff
subject: Trump talking smack
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260226_1.hUL9lY&refcode=em20260226-1&t=1001&akid=5313%2E582294%2Eqdwlet ]Jon Ossoff

Donald
Trump came to Georgia.

The White House sent him here to do damage control on tariffs and health
care.

But he just couldn’t help himself: instead of trying to defend his
price-inflating tariffs and insurance-premium-doubling health care policy,
he resorted to repeating conspiracy theories about the 2020 election — an
election he lost in Georgia despite pressuring Georgia election officials
to “find” him more votes.

Maybe he’s been watching the rallies I’ve been holding across Georgia,
where thousands have turned out in opposition to his corruption and
depravity. Because he took a moment to throw some insults my way.

Now, Donald Trump has been insulting me for a long time. But this time, it
didn’t seem like his heart was in it. I think you could see in his eyes
and hear in his voice that he knows he’s lost the American people. That he
knows his Presidency is slipping away. That he can feel Georgians, and
people nationwide, preparing to deliver a decisive rebuke of historic
abuses of power.

Because as I travel across Georgia, what I hear is more and more people of
every background and belief reject Trump’s chaos and corruption. And it's
not just Democrats and independents. It’s Republicans too!

More and more Republicans take me aside, or they call me on the phone.
They tell me they don’t like where this President has taken us. And they
tell me they’re going to support a Democrat for the first time.

But here’s the thing: as he gets more desperate, his abuses become more
dangerous. From sending Tulsi Gabbard on ballot raids in Fulton County,
Georgia, to threatening a national takeover of elections, we have to be
ready for anything.

We have to turn out LANDSLIDE margins of victory ... victories so decisive
that no scheme or plot hatched in the White House can foil the will of the
people.

And we have to defend voting rights with unprecedented tenacity and
resources.

I need your help to do these things.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260226_1.hUL9lY&refcode=em20260226-1&t=1002&akid=5313%2E582294%2Eqdwlet ]If you’re able to, please split $5 right now between
Chris Pappas and my reelection campaign for U.S. Senate. Most people
donate $30 but any amount is a big help.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260226_1.hUL9lY&amount=5&refcode=em20260226-1&t=1021&akid=5313%2E582294%2Eqdwlet ]Donate $5 »

Remember — in 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat
here couldn’t be done. We built the strongest voter mobilization programs
in Senate campaign history, and we won. That victory secured the Senate
majority.

Now we must win again. We will win again.

Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.

Thanks for your help with this,

Jon

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=5313%2E582294%2Eqdwlet

This is a defining moment for election integrity in America.

The SAVE America Act just PASSED the House of Representatives by a vote of 218-213 and is now on its way to the United States Senate.

The bill requires proof of U.S. citizenship (a passport or birth certificate) to register to vote in federal elections and a photo ID to vote nationwide.

We need photo IDs in America to:
* Drive a car
* Get on an airplane
* Buy alcohol
* Open a bank account
* Get a job or file for unemployment

Major polls even show that an overwhelming majority of both Republican and Democrat voters support voter ID requirements: **Pew Research Center:**
_83% of Americans support government-issued photo ID for voting (95% Republicans, 71% Democrats); 16% oppose._ **Gallup:**
_84% of Americans support photo ID for voting (98% Republicans, 84% independents, 67% Democrats); 83% support proof of citizenship for first-time voter registration._ [So why are Democrats arguing against common-sense safeguards that are supported by an emphatic majority of Americans? >>](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=6028343912094f8bb90c918b8fee57b9&_e=KQq9Ai308WXOHbwn1mMz18GYkkojzxAQik7I2ZAxT6k348sNu09RhoCF2e7eeh-JzCE29DiBg6-09_eR-G6vy2DxVQ98zP_ht_CCaQnDwthfvoaNS096UMzkT8M47okWcIBUxVbQ0DxXapxdIA4JQFx3ggqMDZyxWRqHuFO1zg2bLXzkBXP_3ZPN4ac7aLTPUgcXpH-U_J0hxGEj2nhHbFxCYylsmi9NgqCJNZpG97GAzrM2LUl2H5RE7VwXh4xsakre2z2NdQWAT00S1cdv23Kg8MLGalrTE2S_v3NZlDCY68KHcVqPY1uaDUf6xoRY3KWcj_leXjDva_GpTLSKhHcJhQPHKAocWfKE3vBIcDtwwgzsbIPtJp3V_cNEpIrCI8LEPpp_nVHFn3U8J_LKIwBFDrmA-OxynbhT67VgoLhU1TsduTPLZYUyMm8NzPoMmMvOWZudTb2gRtaOVL33xJxOdSezS2sO6fC7oPYxkpcETE5zD78mgaTXB9RSUtDCtgQ5pu9tbK0MJFVPCp70QMHN6wF_f3zbw7YqFj4GHfgzbx8Pt-jS1TIAsdniXtwv4Xo5r3ygTcvbuhLiAyhothIDxtcDRLtAt7sUxrULDdE%3D)

body:
How to support Wisconsin farmers
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260226-2558)
Peter,
I'm a chef. I've spent my career working with Wisconsin farmers — sourcing ingredients, building relationships, learning what it takes to put food on people's tables.
So when I read that farm bankruptcies in Wisconsin surged 700% last year, it hit me in the gut.
Sixteen Wisconsin farms filed for bankruptcy in 2025. The year before, it was two. Nationally, farm bankruptcies are at their highest point since 2020 — up 46% — and the Midwest is getting hit hardest.
Last week, the Supreme Court ruled that Trump's sweeping tariffs were unconstitutional. But for Wisconsin's farmers, the damage is already done.
Tariffs have slammed our corn and soybean farmers, shutting them out of export markets overnight. Input costs — fuel, seed, equipment, labor — keep climbing. Dairy and hog margins are tightening. And the federal crackdown on immigrant workers is gutting the labor force that keeps our farms running. Immigrant workers make up 12% of Wisconsin's agricultural workforce. You can't rip that out and expect things to hold together.
The USDA projects farm debt will hit a record $624.7 billion this year. Experts are saying 2026 will be worse.
None of this had to happen. These are policy choices. And they can be undone with better ones.
**That's why my platform puts Wisconsin farmers first — not Big Ag corporations:**
I'm calling for a Wisconsin Public Bank that gives small farms access to affordable loans instead of forcing them to max out credit lines and retirement savings just to survive another season.
I'll break up the agricultural monopolies that let a handful of corporations set prices so low that farmers can't cover their costs — while consumers still pay more at the register.
I'll fight for a Farmland Preservation Trust to protect agricultural land from speculation and keep it in the hands of the next generation of farmers.
I'll defend every farm worker's right to fair wages and safe conditions — including the immigrant workers who keep our dairy industry alive and who are being terrorized by this administration.
And I'll expand programs like Badger Box so Wisconsin farmers are feeding Wisconsin families — keeping money and food in our communities.
I grew up in this state. I built my career around the people who grow our food. I refuse to watch them get squeezed out by corporate monopolies and reckless federal policy while politicians look the other way.
**[If you believe Wisconsin's farmers deserve a governor who will actually fight for them, chip in today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260226._wnxfw&refcode=em20260226-2558&t=1&akid=2558%2E105371%2EiaZUqO)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260226._wnxfw&amount=5&refcode=em20260226-2558&t=20&akid=2558%2E105371%2EiaZUqO)**
With gratitude,
— Fran

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: "These People Are Crazy" - Trump goes off script at The State of The Union
body:
Plus: Nicki Minaj just ended Gavin Newsom's 2028 campaign| New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=fc092d8aa2&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
Not one Democrat stood. Not one. Trump looked at them during his speech and said what half the country was thinking. [Even CNN admitted afterward](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=fdf4c795bb&e=567664f14c) — it worked. Meanwhile, Nicki Minaj just ended Gavin Newsom's week in a way nobody saw coming.

Join us for an all new **No Doubt About It Podcast episode!**
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=c28e83fdca&e=567664f14c)
| |
🔥 **"THESE PEOPLE ARE CRAZY" — TRUMP GOES OFF SCRIPT AT THE STATE OF THE UNION**

Trump asked Democrats to stand and say their first duty is to American citizens. Not one did. Then he brought up banning child gender transitions — an 80/20 issue. Still nothing. He looked at them and said three words that weren't in the speech: "These people are crazy." Even CNN's post-speech numbers backed him up.

🚨 **ALL 5 NM REPS BOYCOTTED THE STATE OF THE UNION
** Every single New Mexico congressional representative skipped it. Stansbury showed up last year with a protest sign. This year she didn't bother showing up at all. Mark and Krysty break down what that says about who these five actually work for.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=24a77029e9&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🎤 **NICKI MINAJ TORCHES NEWSOM OVER HIS ATLANTA APPEARANCE**
Newsom told a crowd he's "a 960 SAT guy" who can't read a speech. Nicki Minaj saw the clip and went scorched earth — accusing him of deliberately dumbing himself down and talking to the audience like children. Then the LA rebuild numbers came out. The gap between applications filed and homes actually rebuilt is staggering.

🏅 **NYT CELEBRATES AMERICAN COMPETING FOR CHINA — ATTACKS US HOCKEY TEAM**
The New York Times ran a glowing profile on an American-born skier who competes for China and has never criticized their human rights record. The same outlet then warned the US hockey team about the "dangers" of attending the State of the Union. The double standard is unreal — and her Olympic interview will tell you everything you need to know.
---

subject: re: Kristi Noem & my opponent
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
We need to have an honest conversation about what's happening in our country.

| | |
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5750?t=1&akid=7824%2E400544%2Ej-MDqe)
Here’s the truth, friend: Donald Trump and Kristi Noem’s dangerous agenda is already creeping into New Mexico — and it could go even further if we’re not careful.
**One of my opponents in this race is funded by a Kristi Noem donor.** That’s not random. That’s how this extremist agenda takes hold — through outside money and candidates who are willing to open the door to it. **Extremists see New Mexico as a top target** for their right-wing agenda. If we don’t act now, we risk losing New Mexico to MAGA extremism. [That's why it's so critical that we protect the seat of every Democratic governor — including right here in New Mexico.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5750?t=2&akid=7824%2E400544%2Ej-MDqe) | | | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5750?t=3&akid=7824%2E400544%2Ej-MDqe)
---

When leaders in Washington abuse their power and come after our rights, governors are the last line of defense. That’s how we stop the worst of Kristi Noem’s agenda from taking root here at home. And let’s be clear about what that agenda actually looks like:
1\. Deploying undertrained ICE agents to cities across the nation, tearing families apart and targeting Black and brown communities.

2\. Stoking violence at every turn, causing people to live in fear across the country, including right here in New Mexico.

3\. Putting New Mexico families at risk by holding up over a billion dollars in FEMA funding. Noem is stealing critical funds that allow New Mexicans to recover from and prepare for natural disasters.
If Donald Trump and Kristi Noem want to bring their dangerous, extremist agenda here, they will have to get through my administration.
I will support efforts to require ICE agents operating in our state to identify themselves and remove their masks. We will have zero tolerance for injustice. We will use every authority at our disposal to protect our public spaces — schools, churches, courthouses, healthcare centers, and state facilities.
That’s what it means to be the last line of defense.

That’s exactly why it matters who funds your campaign — because I’m not backed by the people pushing this extremist agenda. I’m backed by New Mexicans. Friend, I've spent my entire career fighting for working families, and I'm not afraid to be a brick wall against Trump and his administration. As governor of New Mexico, I will move our state toward a future where everyone can thrive.
[**_So please, can I count on you to make a donation of $5, $25, or whatever you can spare right now? Together, we can keep New Mexico blue and safeguard our communities against extremism._**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5750?t=4&akid=7824%2E400544%2Ej-MDqe)

body:

Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
GO VOTE:
Cast your ballot to counter MAGA and move Texas forward
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Houston%20-%20Jasmine%20Crockett.JPG]
This is it! The last day to vote early in the Texas Democratic Primary is this Friday, Feb. 27. The next and final chance you'll have to vote in this primary is Election Day -- Tuesday, March 3.
If you caught any of Trump's halfway incoherent State of the Union address [https://www.thedailybeast.com/donald-trumps-state-of-the-union-speech-was-bad-the-actual-state-of-our-union-is-worse/] this week, you know how deeply this nation is in need of a course correction. This primary election is one key way how we can flex our movement's political power and electorally give MAGA a wake up call. Early vote numbers are shattering records, so we have momentum at our back!
Head to the polls and vote for TOP PAC-endorsed candidates [https://organizetexas.org/about-texas-organizing-project-pac/] who have the passion, experience, and tenacity we need to win across Texas in the midterms.
Visit GoVoteTexas.org [https://govotetexas.org/] for polling locations in your county.
TOP BLACK AF:
Celebrating the 100th anniversary of Black History Month with author Michael Harriot
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BB%20and%20Harriot%20-%20BHM%20event.JPG]
This Tuesday was nothing short of memorable, as TOP welcomed critically-acclaimed author Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] (writer of Black AF History [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] ) at our Dallas office, and hosted its first-ever Black History Month symposium.
From the origins of anti-Blackness, to the importance of culture in organizing, to reflections on this volatile political moment, this symposium shined a light on just how powerful our communities are, and how strong our pursuit for liberation is.
WATCH our Facebook reel highlighting the day. [https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1CHczdxsh4/]
Our deepest thanks and gratitude goes out to every attendee, as well as all who made this impactful symposium possible -- including Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, Friendship-West Baptist Church, and The Event Ninjas.
P.S. — Stay tuned for event photos on social media!
VOTE FOR US:
Help TOP host a panel at this year's Netroots Nation conference
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NN20th.png]
TOP applied to host a panel at Netroots Nation this year, and we'd love your VOTE to make this panel a reality. It'll take you less than a minute to show your support, and it'll get us closer to sharing TOP's theory of change on the national stage with hundreds of progressive activists and organizers from across the country.
Just follow these quick steps:
1. Check out our panel topic, "Texas: MAGA before MAGA and how we can still win!" [https://netrootsnation.secure-platform.com/nn26/gallery/rounds/82014/details/12779]
2. Click on the blue "Vote for this submission" button.
3. Create a new account if you need to, or log in to your existing Netroots account.
4. Select our panel and vote!
Feel free to share the panel link on your social media, and use the hashtag #NN26 .
TRUMP TRACKER:
He's militarizing our cities and pushing lawlessness from law enforcement
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20national%20guard%20deployment.jpg]
We're back with another edition of our Trump Tracker , where we apply Critical Ignoring [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] principles to help combat the right-wing's "flood the zone" [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] strategy and refocus to make better sense of the world around us.
Donald Trump and MAGA hacks love to tout him as a "law & order" president, however he's anything but. (Remember we're talking about a twice-impeached official who has more than 30 felony convictions to his name!)
Throughout his first term and now in his second term to an even greater degree, we're seeing Trump use government institutions and agencies to target anyone and everyone he deems as a threat to his authoritarian agenda. We saw it last year in his disturbing deployment of the National Guard in big cities, and we've been witnessing it escalate this year through the increased aggressiveness of ICE and Border Patrol in states like Minnesota.
Just this past week, it was revealed that ICE agents attempted to cover up the unjustifiable killing of yet ANOTHER person [https://www.newsweek.com/ice-agent-fatally-shot-us-citizen-texas-dhs-records-11544225] , a 23-year-old U.S. citizen in South Texas. This pattern of lawless conduct from law enforcement isn't some coincidence; it's being given a pass from the Commander-In-Chief himself.
What's key to keep in mind is this: MAGA's fixation with militarizing our nation's cities isn't about public safety one bit; it's 100% about control and criminalizing communities of color. [https://www.amnestyusa.org/blog/the-racist-subtext-of-trumps-militarized-policing-strategy/]
Español
VOTA:
Emite tu voto para contrarrestar MAGA y hacer que Texas avance
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Houston%20-%20Jasmine%20Crockett.JPG]
¡Este es el momento! El último día para votar anticipadamente en la Primaria Demócrata de Texas es este viernes 27 de febrero. La próxima y última oportunidad para votar en esta primaria será el Día de la Elección — martes 3 de marzo.
Si escuchaste aunque sea una parte del discurso del Estado de la Unión de Trump esta semana [http://www.thedailybeast.com/donald-trumps-state-of-the-union-speech-was-bad-the-actual-state-of-our-union-is-worse/] , aunque se escuchaba medio incoherente, sabes que este país necesita un cambio de rumbo urgente. Esta elección primaria es una manera importante en la que podemos demostrar el poder de nuestro movimiento y mandar un mensaje claro a MAGA por medio del voto. La votación anticipada está rompiendo récords, así que tenemos el impulso de nuestro lado.
Dirígete a las urnas y vota por las candidatas y candidatos respaldados por TOP PAC [https://organizetexas.org/about-texas-organizing-project-pac/] que tienen la pasión, la experiencia y la determinación que necesitamos para ganar en todo Texas en las elecciones intermedias.
Visita GoVoteTexas.org [https://GoVoteTexas.org] para encontrar los centros de votación en tu condado.
TOP BLACK AF:
Celebrando el centenario del Mes de la Historia Afroamericana con el autor Michael Harriot
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BB%20and%20Harriot%20-%20BHM%20event.JPG]
Este martes fue memorable, ya que TOP recibió al aclamado autor Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] (autor del libro Black AF History [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] ) en nuestra oficina de Dallas y organizó su primer simposio del Mes de la Historia Afroamericana.
Desde los orígenes del anti-negritud hasta la importancia de la cultura en la organización y las reflexiones sobre este volátil momento político, este simposio destacó el poder de nuestras comunidades y la firmeza de nuestra búsqueda de la liberación.
VEA nuestro video de Facebook que destaca el día. [https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1CHczdxsh4/]
Nuestro más sincero agradecimiento a todos los asistentes, así como a todos los que hicieron posible este impactante simposio, incluyendo a Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, la Iglesia Bautista Friendship-West y The Event Ninjas.
P. D.: ¡Estén atentos a las fotos del evento en redes sociales!

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NN20th.png]
TOP solicitó organizar un panel en Netroots Nation este año, y nos encantaría contar con su VOTO para hacerlo realidad. Le tomará menos de un minuto mostrar su apoyo , y nos ayudará a acercarnos a compartir la teoría de cambio de TOP en el escenario nacional con cientos de activistas y organizadores progresistas de todo el país.
Solo sigue estos pasos:
1. Consulta el tema de nuestro panel: "Texas: ¡MAGA antes de MAGA y cómo aún podemos ganar!" [https://netrootsnation.secure-platform.com/nn26/gallery/rounds/82014/details/12779]
2. Haz clic en el botón azul "Vota por esta propuesta."
3. Crea una cuenta nueva si lo necesitas o inicia sesión en tu cuenta de Netroots.
4. ¡Selecciona nuestro panel y vota!
Comparte el enlace del panel en tus redes sociales y usa la etiqueta #NN26 .
RASTREADOR DE TRUMP:
Está militarizando nuestras ciudades y alejando a las fuerzas del orden de la anarquía
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20national%20guard%20deployment.jpg]
Regresamos con una nueva edición de nuestro Rastreador de Trump , donde aplicamos los principios de Ignorar de Forma Crítica [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] para combatir la estrategia de la derecha de saturar el espacio [http://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] con información y volver a enfocarnos para entender mejor el mundo que nos rodea.
Donald Trump y los operadores de MAGA presumen que él es un presidente de “ley y orden”, pero la realidad es muy distinta. Estamos hablando de un funcionario que fue sometido a juicio político dos veces y que tiene más de 30 condenas por delitos graves en su historial.
A lo largo de su primer mandato y ahora, en mayor medida durante su segundo mandato, estamos viendo cómo Trump utiliza instituciones y agencias gubernamentales para atacar a cualquier persona que considere una amenaza para su agenda autoritaria. Lo vimos el año pasado con el preocupante despliegue de la Guardia Nacional en grandes ciudades, y lo hemos estado viendo intensificarse este año con el aumento en la agresividad de ICE y la Patrulla Fronteriza en estados como Minnesota.
La semana pasada, se reveló que agentes del ICE intentaron encubrir el asesinato injustificable de OTRA persona [https://www.newsweek.com/ice-agent-fatally-shot-us-citizen-texas-dhs-records-11544225] , un ciudadano estadounidense de 23 años, en el sur de Texas. Este patrón de conducta ilegal por parte de las fuerzas del orden no es casualidad; el propio Comandante en Jefe lo está tolerando.
Lo clave es recordar lo siguiente: la obsesión de MAGA con la militarización de las ciudades de nuestro país no tiene nada que ver con la seguridad pública; se trata 100% de control y criminalización de las comunidades de color. subject: BIG NEWS! Students for Life Action Endorses Tom Willis for U.S. Senate
body:
Tom Willis has a 100% pro-life rating.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/07bf04dca881/stand-with-tom-willis-to-protect-wv-the-border-8343504?e=a0285cc040)

# BIG NEWS! Students for Life Action Endorses Tom Willis for U.S. Senate
---
|
---
|
---
| | Dear Friend,
We’re excited to share a new major endorsement.
On February 20, 2026, [Students for Life Action](https://tomwillis.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3634ddeac3944e116590ee972&id=7ca643ef9b&e=a0285cc040) (SFLAction) President Kristan Hawkins officially endorsed Tom Willis for the U.S. Senate seat currently held by Sen. Shelley Moore Capito... and her words say it all.
“I am honored to have the opportunity to thank Tom Willis for his unwavering defense of Life and to endorse him for U.S. Senator for West Virginia on behalf of Students for Life,” Hawkins said. “Tom Willis will provide a much-needed pro-life vote and voice in Congress for my home state of West Virginia. Families are the building blocks of society, and Willis has expanded on his values as a dedicated, Christian family man to be a strong protector for all children, in and out of the womb.”
During his time in the State Senate, Tom has earned a 100% pro-life rating and consistently backed legislation that protects both unborn children and their mothers.
He completed the West Virginians for Life survey, supporting efforts to inform women about Chemical Abortion Pill reversal, opposing physician-assisted suicide, committing to oppose abortion, and standing with mothers who choose Life.
Tom also sponsored SFLAction’s “Anti-Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking Act” (SB 173) and, as Chairman of the Judiciary Committee, pushed it out of committee. The bill would impose criminal and civil liabilities on Chemical Abortion Pill vendors, another clear example of Tom turning pro-life principles into real action.
As Hawkins said, “Willis has proven his pro-life leadership by supporting multiple pro-life bills during his time in the West Virginia Senate. His boldness for LIFE will make him a much-needed voice in Washington D.C. where too many Republicans will ask for our vote but not act on the human rights issue of our day once they get in office.”
Tom doesn’t just talk about being pro-life. He takes action, leads that way, and votes to protect the unborn. We’re grateful for the support of Students for Life Action and are proud to continue this fight for Life all the way to Washington.
---

## FBI Employees Fired Over Classified Files Case
FBI Director Kash Patel [fired at least 10 FBI employees](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO3DAQRE9DZT0gW79RwMCJsnXqUOCnKbVNkQuSO_Lc3pCvsFkBBRTqvV8f24fhyGn_aU7SLeQt0VUjtUZlC5YDF057TdRC5L-UfLXsw4YSJ5AIOG_ecHxvQ-d1IELqO9JqnlEtcpzG7tBKeWX7xfknLk87PjEQmmE0k5ezW0bqWN9rEnFWSi44PGaLSDigsiRd30sxSPLccnn8zpzaQSG-84vKw-Wzi_po7bOK_ofAVeB6XdfD2XpT3L3A9Y4CV9MgkqkNlIRgGWozIVCpcB0Zrlz-kIec4DQFDESzZ_DZfZ2UWgVnKoEpBIELeaj5qziqUM1b4NoV7T8vjpHrNItB7qfh-P9b-5bQl8Z_AQAA__9Sx4vB) on Wednesday who were connected to the investigation into President Trump's handling of classified documents at his Mar-a-Lago estate. The firings followed revelations that the FBI had [subpoenaed phone records](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O3SAURleDOyy42GZcUESK3E3alBY_l-ebwWAB8zyz--hlC6k_6dM55_f7_m4pUX78sieaHsue8W4Je8e6R0eRKuVHy9hjoi_MoTkKcQcBCxfAQe_BUvrepyGYiAioBjRSa5CrmJd5OAxqGaSNS3TRwzypqKawTqsNLiiH8zyQeb0JAC2lWGEatQNAmEA6FF4pwSaBgXqp459CuR8Y03d5Yh19OYdkjt6vxtQPBhuD7b7vMZavl8VrZ7BdJVEn3xhs0RFvn-4qmC2_jpKRV_SlhsYT2ic23uvneXF_EEbeuo2RU-btKP6DV7xK7UxtZyv-gwJTP4Wa9Zt7c9KvevFuEUotK0qUwYYlKDtUE66bUqK2aDaJx2kp_cPu_9X6aeBvAAAA__9IyZSM) of Patel and White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles while the two were private citizens during the Biden administration. Patel accused previous FBI leadership of using flimsy pretexts and evading oversight in its investigation. The dismissed staff ranged from [support personnel to agents and supervisors](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1y5CAQhJ9GythCgxbWAcElynzphSp-Bml8CFQwa53f_mr9Co67q6u_78_7-u4oU9l-uwMtp7oWvHpGZmxr8pSoUdl6QU6Z_mGJ3VNMK0jQQoIAs0ZH-Wudx2gTIqAa0U7GwPQm7_o-7lahS8rN_pEewSSl_cM_nJFRax3uAeJI9rUmAcw0yTeYb8YDIMwweZRBKTnMEiNxbbePSoV3TPmrfmK7hXqM2e7MZx_UrwGWAZbrum7FhxfFKx9gOWsmptAHWD6enSmgiHi6xgcWHmD56_ouTseYRaKGXSRPwm1YuAsmjOJwTWS3VdHRtbALbs_jFLGG5_FdaqE40NLMamw2nhflTF2bYZbb4Sh_3-Qfuf208D8AAP__x8ORAw), all tied to former Special Counsel Jack Smith's classified documents probe. The FBI Agents Association condemned the firings, saying they violate employees' due process rights and weaken the bureau by stripping away critical expertise.

Patel accused previous FBI leadership of using flimsy pretexts and evading oversight in its investigation. Chain Stores Facing 2026 'Retail Apocalypse' Over 1,200 U.S. retail stores are , as major chains including Macy's, Pizza Hut, Kroger, Wendy's, and Saks Off 5th shutter underperforming locations in what experts are calling a retail apocalypse. The closures follow a record-setting 2025, when thousands of U.S. stores permanently shut their doors. Rising operating costs, declining foot traffic, and the continued shift toward online shopping are driving the trend. Other Carter's, which plans to close 150 stores over three years; Yankee Candle, shuttering 20 locations; Rite Aid, closing all remaining stores after a second bankruptcy filing; and Amazon, which announced plans to shut down all 57 Amazon Fresh and 15 Amazon Go locations. Forrester Research predicts the pressure on retailers will intensify, among specialty retailers and a broader industry pivot toward profitability over expansion. AI-powered shopping tools and stricter digital return policies are also expected to reshape the sector. Tech Companies Roll Out New Child Protections Tech companies are rolling out aimed at empowering parents as a major ongoing trial in Los Angeles tests whether Meta and YouTube deliberately designed addictive platforms that harmed children's mental health. Meta’s Instagram announced Thursday that it will soon alert parents when teenage children repeatedly search for content related to suicide or self-harm, part of Meta's latest effort to shore up safety features as it faces heat over how social media impacts young people. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. ---
Friend, They tried to break us. At UC Berkeley — one of the most hostile, left-wing campuses in America — ANTIFA tried to shut down our final campus tour stop of 2025. They showed up hours early. Wearing masks. Lighting flares and smoke bombs. Throwing paint and glass bottles at attendees. Waving Mexican and rainbow flags. They mocked Charlie's assassination... pointing to their own necks where he was shot. They chanted: _"F*** Charlie Kirk"... "No safe space for fascist scum"... "Fascists out of Berkeley."_ And they rushed police barricades, hoping to break through and disrupt our final campus tour stop of the semester.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4afq&__onlt=h)
---
ANTIFA surrounded the venue, blocking every entrance. Even after our students and attendees were leaving, ANTIFA located their exit and continued to meet them with violence. The mob swarmed every student, speaker, and parent who came to hear a message of faith, family, and freedom. A mother holding her two daughters was forced to push through a wall of protesters screaming profanity in her children's faces. Another attendee, blood dripping from his brow, was pulled to safety after being struck in the chaos outside the event. These out-of-control Leftists weren't satisfied with merely being heard in protest — _They wanted to pick a fight._ Police made multiple arrests. **UC Berkeley, a so-called "bastion" of free speech, turned into a war zone.**
---
| | [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4afq&__onlt=h)
---

Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie's legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: **Truth is louder than hate.**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12932570?e=d1c1b9864f)

| | | | |
---
| |
# NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,
**We just finished up Week 6 of Session, and things are moving along quickly!** I continue working alongside my colleagues to advance legislation that puts Florida first, with a focus on protecting freedoms, supporting families, and strengthening Florida’s future. I look forward to sharing updates as the session continues.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=54e693904c&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
# PROPERTY TAX BILL PASSES the HOUSE FLOOR!
---
| | The Florida House of Representatives approved a joint resolution, [**HJR203**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=48f3d0207f&e=d1c1b9864f), on Thursday to put in motion a possible constitutional amendment on the November ballot that would completely end non-school property taxes for homesteaded properties beginning on January 1, 2027.
---
|
---
| | **Click here to watch my debate:** [**https://www.facebook.com/reel/3917061915258152**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b194ea0c3b&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.facebook.com/reel/3917061915258152")
I was proud to stand and say what many Floridians already know. The increase in local government spending is out of control, and the solution is right in front of us. **Reduce and eventually eliminate property taxes, and let the tourists and new movers pay for it.**
My remarks here are in support of [**Rep. Monique Miller for State Representative District 33 legislation**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b9f0acd85c&e=d1c1b9864f) , which would eliminate property taxes on homesteads (except for the taxes levied by school districts). This is a powerful step in the right direction.
**My legislation would be a COMPLETE elimination of property taxes,** with an appropriate replacement through other revenue collection, and I truly believe this is where Florida is headed. We cannot continue to allow a system of taxation that takes your property if you can't pay the taxes.
Under that system, we are mere renters, and the government is the ultimate owner of our property. That is simply unacceptable and un-American, and it's certainly not how things should be done in the Free State of Florida.
Consider the data. Local government revenue has outpaced personal income by 2 to 1. That’s totally unacceptable. We must start cutting now and pursue full elimination of property taxes.
**This is the start of a new era for the State of Florida.**
---
| |
# Bills Presented:
---
| |
* [**HB 529**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=00a858c78f&e=d1c1b9864f) made it through its second committee and has been added to the Judiciary Committee agenda.
* **Why I Filed This Bill:** Community-Based Care (CBC) lead agencies and their contracted providers are experiencing a significant insurance coverage crisis. Since foster care and related services were outsourced, liability insurance costs have increased substantially, while the number of commercial insurers willing to underwrite these policies in Florida has declined sharply. As a result, very few carriers remain in this market.

* [**If you'd like to follow my bills, please click: Representative Ryan Chamberlin2026- Sponsored Bills | Florida House of Representatives**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=5b180071b9&e=d1c1b9864f "https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=ded723add5&e=a696a6dd1a")

---
| |
# Events/Receptions This Week:
---
| | This week, I attended several events in Tallahassee, including the **Florida Ocean’s Day Reception.** It was a great opportunity to spend time with colleagues and leaders while recognizing important work taking place across our state.
---
| |
# Meetings This Week:
---
|
---
| | I had the opportunity to meet with **AMIkids** to learn more about their work supporting young people through education, workforce development, and life skills programs that help them build confidence and succeed.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Great meeting with the **Center for Independent Living of North Central Florida** to discuss the important work they do to empower individuals with disabilities and promote independence throughout our community.
From providing essential services and advocacy to helping individuals live more self-sufficient lives, their impact across North Central Florida is truly inspiring. Thank you for stopping by and for your continued commitment to improving quality of life for so many in our region!
---
|
---
|
---
| | It was great to meet with **Hall of Famer Cris Carter, Former Florida State Head Coach Jimbo Fisher,** and the **Florida Coaches Coalition** to discuss the important role coaches play in mentoring our students and strengthening communities across our state.
From teaching teamwork and discipline to helping young people build confidence and character, coaches have a lasting impact both on and off the field. Thank you for your advocacy, your leadership, and for all you do each day to support Florida’s student-athletes!
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| | Wonderful to meet with **Aviata Health Group of Marion County** and discuss the important role they play in providing quality healthcare and rehabilitation services to residents in our community.
From supporting patients on their road to recovery to ensuring compassionate, high-quality care for families, their work makes a meaningful difference every day. Thank you for taking the time to share your insights and for your continued commitment to serving Marion County and our surrounding communities!
---
| |
# Committees:
---
|
---
| |
**I have the honor of serving on several important committees for the upcoming 2026 Legislative Session.** Week six is now complete, and these meetings continue to shape the policies and priorities we will carry into the new year.
* [**Justice Budget Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=a0cc0c748e&e=d1c1b9864f)**:**[ Justice Budget Subcommittee - 02/12/2026 08:00 AM Meeting Report | Florida House of Representatives](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=042e8dc9ab&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0a755dcddd&e=d1c1b9864f)**:**[ Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee - 02/12/2026 09:15 AM Meeting Report | Florida House of Representatives](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=df9edabb2f&e=d1c1b9864f)
* **Session**

---
|
---
| | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,

The pressing matter of LGBTQ+ rights is of paramount importance, with the well-being and equal treatment of our communities at stake.To ensure justice and equality for all, we must advance LGBTQ+ rights through thoughtful and inclusive legislation.By choosing representatives who advocate for these causes, we pave the way for a more just and equitable society, where the voices of marginalized communities are not only heard but also respected and uplifted.The people across this great nation and those in the 8th District of Texas deserve someone who will fight for their right to lead fulfilling, authentic lives free from discrimination and inequality.[**_If you are ready to see that representation in our state is changed, then please chip in today. | Letter from the Chair
---
Our Nation Is Back: Bigger, Better, Richer, and Stronger Than Ever Before
These stirring words from President Trump's 2026 State of the Union address captured the energy surging through America right now.
A true revival is underway--one that goes far beyond politics. We're witnessing a spiritual awakening, with younger generations flocking to churches in search of timeless tradition and unapologetic orthodoxy. At the same time, a powerful resurgence of patriotism is uniting us as we approach the 250th anniversary of the Signing of the Declaration of Independence in 2026. This milestone isn't just a date on the calendar--it's a celebration of American greatness that will carry us forward with pride and purpose.
President Trump's speech embodied this renewed patriotic fervor, a stark contrast to the subdued tones of recent State of the Union addresses. He boldly celebrated America's exceptionalism and the everyday heroism of its people, reminding us of what makes this country extraordinary.
A particularly moving thread ran through the address: deep respect for mothers. Trump honored:

* Working mothers who power our economy and families every day
* Grieving mothers who have endured unimaginable loss, including those like Anya Zarutska, whose daughter Iryna was tragically taken--highlighting the human cost of failed policies
* Mothers fighting fiercely for their children's safety, futures, and well-being such as Michele Blair who fought against the secret social transitioning her daughter Sage by Virginia school officials.

He spotlighted policies that resonate strongly with everyday Americans, policies that put citizens first:

* The SAVE Act to secure elections and protect the integrity of our vote
* Banning commercial driver's licenses (CDLs) for illegal aliens to enhance road safety (as embodied in proposals like the Dalilah Law)
* Investing in our children's futures through targeted support and opportunity
* Ensuring no new AI data centers drive up electric bills for hardworking families
* Ending insider trading in Congress to restore trust in government
* Prioritizing protection for American citizens over illegal immigrants

Throughout the evening, Democrats remained seated--refusing to stand for these pro-American priorities, for grieving families, or for the promise of a secure and prosperous future.
As John Solomon so aptly put it, the speech drew a clear line in the sand: between the Patriots who cheer America's comeback and the Hatriots who sit in defiance.
This is more than a moment--it's a movement. Our nation is reclaiming its strength, its faith, and its pride. Let's keep building on this momentum as we head toward our historic 250th birthday and the 2026 elections!

A true revival is underway--one that goes far beyond politics. We're witnessing a spiritual awakening, with younger generations flocking to churches in search of timeless tradition and unapologetic orthodoxy. At the same time, a powerful resurgence of patriotism is uniting us as we approach the 250th anniversary of the Signing of the Declaration of Independence in 2026. President Trump's speech embodied this renewed patriotic fervor, a stark contrast to the subdued tones of recent State of the Union addresses. A particularly moving thread ran through the address: deep respect for mothers. This is more than a moment--it's a movement. Our nation is reclaiming its strength, its faith, and its pride. subject: What our students are up against this spring...
body:
The Left’s intimidation campaign is real
One of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced.
| | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=0b8ed235513746c883294813b876781c&_e=pGBJvFCXykcEvj-ty71pK8-cw_Hxt4R7ELKalv7q7nDKGvGDYbeON8Sbu32YoPmFG0sYOtOJ9cGhCx5GQAgABvDDd5287KjUuPLERDXxkb6Mh4u3q595NMaA10iAooCO-3JXLKu4ceMRYHJPAyOXRooMLlxSU5-MdvucCpBKfQQ8inNOqiI81FrfO1VU3YOUW0iqAj59l_K2zv-TPJUS4IhY9yY8C-zNHC4E5rD-zFHHptaVtC7xEO8VcAOk5yxopi7eylXWUrEHs3BWk5QB7d70yDN8AQrQiJLRDD1mySzN2NYpL1n-FiPEBE1EyLdQxCFFrGVdTZtVOLyiL6-zmUTQ0bf1n_DYfWVVptp9Dms0Lr8Y2uLI_RD08_PdOtw4ouACUHBpnpRWJ8bCqTW5optS1KGJadUtkK0uEkRZ7b27QGJpL20KP6HEJiG3hA0WxScIJ4P_PrG71fmkYSDZ5on0fYMsijXsf63YACfrRWBAv6S6uHXoR-6V3ePB-gInDR42lb_KQSgb0HShIZjpT3K8nLNFgeyry4-nhQqXZH34zB09vgCM85f1_F6SinKJW7btknT40KfQ9IKO8tIRXdE-lxLZgkomKoL4fbFBvGPHmnI9StegRoCLj7pUkZnmMISqEkFM7DVtY_wO7tIBfT6kHtIv6j5-L4YOvFnQY3Oo49LrOVWGfKofDfFMS5QRXL5rkamC0OnEhD19rnplQA%3D%3D)
---
| | Peter,
---
I have to say it...

The campus climate this spring?

_It 's been downright ugly._

To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast...

But this semester is different.

**This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. **

From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- _physically attacked. _

All for saying what you and I know to be true:

That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something.

And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down.

They didn't run. They didn't hide.

They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before.

_But not without cost. _

**Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... **

In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December.

It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book.

And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting...

A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children."

Then she went even further.

She told the board: _" All members of this Board are mandatory reporters... Based on the circumstances surrounding this event, **a report was made to Child Protective Services. " **_

Yes, you read that right -- she weaponized CPS against one of our students.

Filed against a **minor. **

For organizing a pro-America Turning Point USA event with his friends.

Now, I want you to imagine being 17 years old... doing everything right... following every rule... showing up with courage and conviction...

And then hearing a stranger stand up in front of your entire community and imply that you're a danger to children.

That you need to be investigated. That you're the problem.
---
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=0b8ed235513746c883294813b876781c&_e=pGBJvFCXykcEvj-ty71pK8-cw_Hxt4R7ELKalv7q7nDKGvGDYbeON8Sbu32YoPmFG0sYOtOJ9cGhCx5GQAgABvDDd5287KjUuPLERDXxkb6Mh4u3q595NMaA10iAooCO-3JXLKu4ceMRYHJPAyOXRooMLlxSU5-MdvucCpBKfQQ8inNOqiI81FrfO1VU3YOUW0iqAj59l_K2zv-TPJUS4IhY9yY8C-zNHC4E5rD-zFHHptaVtC7xEO8VcAOk5yxoI7qNPXQc4tVxJ8C5RSPj9K8Vrl9s4rqgbk1STT-S7lfJkW_6fefsUtZBn0ONm4tmtOpMqK4XRcbJL6MythmdF1LTGmOOF4H-qup9RnL0ZUAuQdmLvroBaLOG7-zT1Y4XmjPhHoVmUB98NDqyCrCio4_omMNPHPjwxnA2fhjr_ySbzl9JNls42NsJ5R6-1YMaztiXH_xnFLxtcHYVYeNiTjU4yCtDWCKx0Uu211mbekPZzwj4QCbefd8shzThGDb-kLOS-9jmY310EdL85MXsSH9WPj9u8Rp3Un1wbnHqPXN7IGqVENCB1xOyQibJgQLfekovZKVmQTyBQi-iMQhnZoxda1Eq2fpT5d6YpgMwoPToZZocgR6yHZ7HTgUXHoBSNl62YZblDZwEUBW8inbZGP84HA4QjUSEjVYiSUWGLOrV92LDKSG8TRyTbWaC6gZEU4iF2nRJjtw5Z5q7CmK9Zg%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** "Nancy" -- the Leftist Karen who filed a CPS report against a local Club America chapter and spoke out against them at a recent school board meeting. _
---
How would _you_ respond?

Because I'll tell you what he did...

He walked up to that microphone -- calm, steady, unshaken -- and said:

_" We have been accused of many things... I'm the president of the group. I'm 17, I'm a minor. I can't groom children because I am a child." _

Seventeen years old. Standing alone. But standing strong in front of his entire community while facing outrageous, malicious accusations.

That's courage. The kind of courage Charlie would've been proud of.

And that courage is catching fire across the country. _But so is the hatred. _

Because what happened in Maryland wasn't an isolated incident... It's just the beginning:

🚨 **At Lawrence University in Wisconsin, Leftists on campus are trying to permanently shut down a brand-new TPUSA chapter before it even starts. **

Never mind that Lawrence has over 160 student clubs... and not one is right-leaning. Or that the university handbook bans discrimination based on political affiliation.

One of our students there is now receiving death threats.

And instead of protecting him?

The Left-wing student government is putting the chapter's fate up to a campus-wide vote.

Not one bit. They're still tabling at campus events. They're still meeting after school -- still recruiting, still growing. They're still passing out pocket Constitutions and American flags. They're still launching chapters in hostile territory -- places where they've been told, outright, that they're not welcome. And while their peers stage "ICE Walkouts" and chaos in the halls... Our students are gathering to pray -- for their schools, for law enforcement, and for this nation -- quietly around their school's flagpole. That's because these students made a decision -- the same decision Charlie challenged them to every day: " It doesn't take skill to be courageous. It takes a choice." They chose courage. They chose to stand for faith, freedom, and family. They chose to defend everything that makes this country worth fighting for. They truly are the courageous generation. In fact, since Charlie 's assassination last September: 🔥 Over 140,000 students raised their hands to get involved 🔥 4,600+ active chapters are now operating across America 🔥 More than 1 million students are part of this movement And Peter, patriots like you are the reason they've been able to do it... Because while the Left mocked Charlie's death-- while the hate followed and the attacks intensified -- you didn't disappear. Patriots like you stood firm. You stood with these students. You made it clear: The mission doesn 't end here. And now, because of your faithfulness, we 're watching the seeds Charlie planted come to life in high schools, colleges, and communities across this country. Our students may not know your name... But they know someone made it possible for them to take a stand on their campus. They're walking into classrooms bolder than ever. Speaking truth in places where lies once ruled. Because someone gave them the chance. That someone was you. Patriots like you reminded these students that they're not alone -- even when it feels like it. You helped push back the darkness. You made space for courage to grow. The kind of courage Charlie lived for. The kind of courage he gave everything for. So, thank you, Peter. Thank you for giving these young patriots a fighting chance. We will not stop. We will not retreat. We will keep standing for truth -- louder and stronger than ever before. Because Charlie's mission didn't end with his life. It's being carried forward -- by thousands of students... and by you. And that 's the one thing the Left can't stand. Let's keep pushing. Let's keep growing. Let's keep going -- together. | | For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. Peter, thank you again for taking a stand for our brave students. It's truly incredible watching these students from across the country lining up to start the next wave of new Turning Point chapters. They're watching what's happening... seeing the attacks... hearing the hate from the Left... And still saying: " Sign me up." All they need? A little backup. Every new chapter receives a full activism kit from Turning Point USA, filled with everything they need to lead boldly: ✅ Pocket Constitutions ✅ American Flags ✅ Chapter Leadership Tools ✅ Organizing Guides ✅ Patriotic TPUSA Gear Each one costs just $25 to send to a student chapter. You don't need to start a chapter yourself. But you can help a new one get off the ground. And you can be the reason a kid on a hostile campus doesn't feel like they're fighting alone. ** 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

#
Peter —
I wanted to follow up on the spending decisions I told you we had to make yesterday. As someone who cares about taking back Texas and has invested in this movement, you deserve transparency.
When we talked about our closing strategy, we knew that putting more resources into getting out our message and mobilizing voters would make a significant impact on Tuesday. The race is going to be close, and we can’t leave any stone unturned.
So I told my team that we should spend everything we could — go as close to $0 in our bank account as we could stomach. Leaving a single dollar unspent and coming up short by a few votes would be devastating. Folks put their faith in us to use every resource available, and I take the responsibility very seriously.
We had to move fast and spend big because, as I mentioned, the television and streaming platforms set a deadline for us to pay up front.
So yes, we spent more than we had in the budget, but I gave my team the green light to get our message out in front of the voters who will decide this race in these final days.
It was a risk. But I have faith because I have seen what this team is capable of. I trusted that if I explained my decision to you, enough people who believe in our movement and care about taking back Texas and the Senate majority would come through to fill our budget gap.

Here are just a few of our candidates who will be on the ballot on Tuesday:

**Shannon Dicely - Texas Senate District 11**
Only one woman has ever held this seat – and that was over 50 years ago. Now, Shannon is stepping in to defeat a right-wing Republican who will uphold the status quo. But first, she must win the primary. Shannon is a mother, wife, advocate, and breast cancer survivor. She has seen firsthand how legislation doesn’t just ignore hardworking families in Texas, but hurts them.

**Pooja Sethi – Texas House of Representatives District 47**
Prior to her work in government, Pooja worked as an immigration attorney fighting for dignity and due process for families at their most vulnerable time. That work shaped her commitment to civil rights, human dignity, and access to justice.

This is a historically red district that flipped blue in 2018. Pooja needs our help to protect this seat. _"Every session, we’re told we’re here to fight for children," she told us. "But every session, I’ve watched cruelty win.”_

**Kristian Carranza - Texas House of Representative District 118**
Kristian began her career in community organizing to uplift the voice of working families. She led voter registration drives, helped neighbors enroll for affordable insurance coverage, and managed multi-million dollar budgets. Her fight for healthcare, affordable housing, and jobs that provide for a family is a fight to honor the single mother who raised her, and a community whose work ethic she describes as second to none.

We’ve even launched a partnership with a massive group of volunteers on the ground across the state who will be working overtime from now until Tuesday to spread the word about these candidates.

But we need your support to ensure our volunteers have what they need to get the job done, and that our women candidates have what THEY need to win their primaries on March 3rd. **

The SAVE America Act, which has passed the U.S. House and is headed to the U.S. Senate, is a blatant attack on voting rights that could disenfranchise millions of eligible American citizens from making their voices heard. It is designed to keep certain voters – particularly Black, brown, young, women, and other historically marginalized voters, as well as voters with disabilities – from casting a ballot.

**As someone who has voted here in PA for decades, I know what access looks like. I also know what barriers to the ballot box look like.**

Requiring passports or original birth certificates would hit lower-income voters first. Students who may not be able to afford a passport. Seniors whose birth records are incomplete or difficult to obtain. Married people and adoptees who have changed their names. Americans living abroad, including members of our military and their families overseas. Naturalized citizens who would need to safeguard their original citizenship papers. Voters with disabilities who face additional challenges accessing government offices or navigating complex paperwork. Many of our friends and neighbors, who are otherwise fully eligible voters, would be at risk of being shut out of the democratic process because of the SAVE Act.

**That is not a hypothetical. It is the intended outcome.**

[**This bill is a blatant attempt to strip away at our democracy and put up additional barriers to the ballot box. We need all hands on deck to fight to protect the freedom to vote. name: Ken Martin
subject: Republicans woke up in a panic
body:
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?amount=20&refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)
---
Derek,
On the first day of this month Republicans woke up in a panic. Do you want to know why?
The night before, Democrat Taylor Rehmet won his race and pulled off a 32-point swing in a Texas state senate district that Trump won by 17 points in 2024.
**That’s right — a 32-point swing in _Texas.**_
That day was also my first anniversary as chair of the Democratic National Committee. Frankly, I couldn’t have asked for a better gift.
When I started, Democrats had just suffered a gut-punch loss in 2024. One that had people asking whether our party still understood the country we were fighting to lead.
For me, that’s not an abstract question.
I’m the son of a single mom who struggled to keep our family afloat. I watched her work harder than anyone I knew, making impossible choices, and still worry whether bills would get paid.
**Politics wasn’t theoretical in our house.** It showed up in the rent, the groceries, the cost of health care, and whether the system treated us like an afterthought or as a family worth fighting for.
If the Democratic Party loses sight of people who know struggle firsthand, then no amount of clever messaging or campaign tactics will save us. That’s why we’re organizing around working people — not just to rebuild our majority, but to make clear what our purpose is.
That’s what we’ve been doing at the DNC: investing the money, resources, and talent to build lasting political power to win congressional elections, state races, and local seats.
But this work — winning and delivering for working Americans — is only possible with grassroots donations. Seriously.
**Derek, our end-of-month fundraising deadline is coming up tomorrow. These deadlines might seem arbitrary, but they’re not. Our team sets monthly goals that help determine how much money Democrats can allocate to different priorities.**
[**So I’m asking: if you’re able, can you make a $7 contribution before midnight tomorrow to help us reach our end-of-month goal? We’ll put your donation directly to work electing Democrats.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&amount=7&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._
| | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)**
---

| **[Donate $25](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)**

****
| **[Donate $100](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $250](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?express_lane=true&amount=250&refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2026?refcode=em_20260227_6241_fr&refcode2=6241_22930333_pzwdaa&akid=6241%2E22930333%2Epzwdaa)**
---
****
Right now, Democrats have real wind at our backs. Since Trump took office, Republicans have flipped zero state legislative seats. Zero. Democrats have flipped 26.
We’ve seen political earthquakes like we saw in Texas _every_ month — hell, nearly every week — for the past year. As I’ve been saying, it’s not an anomaly if it’s happening weekly. We elected Democratic governors in Virginia and New Jersey. Supreme Court justices in Pennsylvania. Passed Proposition 50 in California. **None of this happened by accident.**
At the DNC, we’ve followed a simple philosophy: organize everywhere. Not just one region. Not in a few battleground states. Everywhere.
During times like these, I think about my mom. About how she never had the luxury of giving up when things got hard. About how hope, for her, was never abstract. It was built slowly, through discipline, sacrifice, and showing up even when the odds weren’t kind.
When Democrats take back Congress this year, and I believe we will, the real work will begin.
We will govern with the seriousness this moment demands and the humility to remember who sent us here.
I welcome that pressure. We all should. Pressure is what keeps a party honest. It’s what reminds us that power is not something you possess, it’s something you’re entrusted with.
And that, for me, is where hope begins.
Best,
Ken
Ken Martin
Chair
Democratic National Committee

name: Patrick J. Murphy
subject: The 40-Day Reset in a 24-Hour Culture
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM_Logo.png]
To those who know me, it’s no secret that I’m a huge fan of Scott Galloway, the NYU Stern marketing professor and bestselling author of books like The Algebra of Wealth and Adrift .
What keeps me coming back to his work isn’t just his expert business analysis, but his broader commentary on how our digital world has created a social fallout.
His latest book, Notes on Being a Man describes the male loneliness epidemic in which relationships and institutions that used to give life structure and meaning have hollowed out. This has been boosted by social media platforms engineered for addictive behavior.
Social media is fragmenting our attention and changing our overall psyche, including in business with the attention economy. Galloway has spent years documenting this as well as what impatience costs us. Average stock holding periods have collapsed from eight years in the 1960s to under six months [https://www.weforum.org/stories/2021/12/long-term-investing-decline/] today. About 78% of CFOs [https://bit.ly/4rBWzjz] admit they'd sacrifice long-term value to hit a quarterly number. We've built an economy that structurally punishes patience.
And we've built lives to match.
The average American teen spends seven-plus hours a day on screens [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/29/health/common-sense-kids-media-use-report-wellness] outside of school work. SEVEN HOURS. Alcohol-related death jumped 38% between 2019 and 2021. [https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/news-events/research-update/alcohol-related-deaths-which-increased-during-first-year-covid-19-pandemic-continued-rise-2021] Male close friendships have been cut in half since 1990 [https://www.americansurveycenter.org/why-mens-social-circles-are-shrinking/] . The platforms designed to connect us are running the same playbook: stimulate, hook, normalize, repeat.
None of this is a moral failure. It's a systems design problem. The system is working exactly as intended, and our children and young adults are the output.
This is exactly why Lent is such an important practice in modern times.
Forty days of subtraction in a culture that only knows addition has a powerful effect. This structured interruption has been built into the calendar for 1,700 years before anyone invented a dopamine slot machine in their pocket.
When you give something up for 40 days, you're not just abstaining. You're running a self-diagnostic. What do you reach for without thinking? What fills the silence? The answer is usually more revealing than people expect.
Galloway makes another point worth holding: the people who compound, economically, professionally, physically, are almost always the ones who can delay gratification because impulse is expensive. The longitudinal data on self-control and lifetime earnings [https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/news-events/research-update/alcohol-related-deaths-which-increased-during-first-year-covid-19-pandemic-continued-rise-2021] is about as clean as social science gets.
So, aside from religious observance, there is real personal fulfillment in practicing Lent. And for those of you who aren’t Catholic, you can apply this idea in your own life regardless of faith.
Try deleting social media apps from your phone for a week, or going offline from Friday night to Sunday morning. Set a rule: no phone before 8am or after 9pm. Turn off every notification except calls and texts. Read a physical book before bed instead of scrolling. Eat one meal a day without a screen in front of you. Small changes add up. When you remove excess from your life, your inner clarity will add up.
I'm making the same argument Galloway makes about sleep and training and financial discipline: restraint is a structural advantage in a world that profits from your impulsiveness. The wealthy increasingly practice it. The masses are increasingly sold the alternative.
When it comes to Lent, forty days feels like an eternity right now, but you’ll see that change rewards you by being grounded in the things that matter. This year, I’m focused on implementing what I’ve described above, as well as giving up alcohol and saying at least one rosary each week.
What are you doing?
You can respond to my Instagram story [https://www.instagram.com/stories/patrickmurphypa/3841793141355097749?utm_source=ig_story_item_share&igsh=MXNxYm1vYWdkcmNnYw==] here.
- Patrick
