clean_body: [] To those who know me, it’s no secret that I’m a huge fan of Scott Galloway, the NYU Stern marketing professor and bestselling author of books like The Algebra of Wealth and Adrift . What keeps me coming back to his work isn’t just his expert business analysis, but his broader commentary on how our digital world has created a social fallout. His latest book, Notes on Being a Man describes the male loneliness epidemic in which relationships and institutions that used to give life structure and meaning have hollowed out. This has been boosted by social media platforms engineered for addictive behavior. Social media is fragmenting our attention and changing our overall psyche, including in business with the attention economy. Galloway has spent years documenting this as well as what impatience costs us. Average stock holding periods have collapsed from eight years in the 1960s to under six months [] today. About 78% of CFOs [] admit they'd sacrifice long-term value to hit a quarterly number. We've built an economy that structurally punishes patience. And we've built lives to match. The average American teen spends seven-plus hours a day on screens [] outside of school work. SEVEN HOURS. Alcohol-related death jumped 38% between 2019 and 2021. [] Male close friendships have been cut in half since 1990 [] . The platforms designed to connect us are running the same playbook: stimulate, hook, normalize, repeat. None of this is a moral failure. It's a systems design problem. The system is working exactly as intended, and our children and young adults are the output. This is exactly why Lent is such an important practice in modern times. Forty days of subtraction in a culture that only knows addition has a powerful effect. This structured interruption has been built into the calendar for 1,700 years before anyone invented a dopamine slot machine in their pocket. When you give something up for 40 days, you're not just abstaining. You're running a self-diagnostic. What do you reach for without thinking? What fills the silence? The answer is usually more revealing than people expect. Galloway makes another point worth holding: the people who compound, economically, professionally, physically, are almost always the ones who can delay gratification because impulse is expensive. The longitudinal data on self-control and lifetime earnings [] is about as clean as social science gets. So, aside from religious observance, there is real personal fulfillment in practicing Lent. And for those of you who aren’t Catholic, you can apply this idea in your own life regardless of faith. Try deleting social media apps from your phone for a week, or going offline from Friday night to Sunday morning. Set a rule: no phone before 8am or after 9pm. Turn off every notification except calls and texts. Read a physical book before bed instead of scrolling. Eat one meal a day without a screen in front of you. Small changes add up. When you remove excess from your life, your inner clarity will add up. I'm making the same argument Galloway makes about sleep and training and financial discipline: restraint is a structural advantage in a world that profits from your impulsiveness. The wealthy increasingly practice it. The masses are increasingly sold the alternative. When it comes to Lent, forty days feels like an eternity right now, but you’ll see that change rewards you by being grounded in the things that matter. This year, I’m focused on implementing what I’ve described above, as well as giving up alcohol and saying at least one rosary each week. What are you doing? **“Here, right matters.”**
That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126257244/604401049/-103424466?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5707-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDBjOThhYS1lZDEzLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vudeqsT6c0TGsY0QsHtyVRmFYPlfCPxasmhQCppMV8k=)

I knew that I was assuming a lot of risk by challenging the most powerful person in the world. There was no doubt that he was going to use everything in his power to retaliate, just as he’d done to his opponents in the past.
**_[But I had confidence that I could tell the truth. I knew that this is America — and here, right matters. Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past but we’ve overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union.

We have a troubling update about Democrats' first major election of the year.
New polling in the April 7 Wisconsin Supreme Court election shows this race on a knife's edge. Judge Chris Taylor leads by just 5 points and 66% of voters are still undecided.
That means this election is a dead heat and could swing either way. And if our voters don't turn out, MAGA could seize this crucial Supreme Court seat.

If MAGA candidate Maria Lazar wins, a critical firewall protecting free and fair elections could disintegrate into dust in August 2028, just months before the next presidential election.
If we lose this court, the consequences would be dire for Dems:

* The same court that blocked Trump's election schemes in 2020 could fall into extremist hands

* National momentum could shift toward MAGA just before the midterms

* Wisconsinites could face attacks on fundamental rights -- including reproductive freedom

And here's the most alarming number of all to come out that poll:
55% of Wisconsin voters say they've heard little about this race. 38% say they've heard nothing.
Volatile polling like this is exactly the opening MAGA billionaires look for. If they flood the race with cash in these closing months, they could pull off a coup.
After Elon Musk's public support for the MAGA candidate in 2025 brought national attention to the WI Supreme Court election, they learned their lesson. This year, they are hiding in the bushes waiting for an opportunity just like this.
Last year, Defend Our Courts helped orchestrate a massive landslide victory in the Pennsylvania Supreme Court election. We proved we can win these fights. But right now, we don't yet have the resources to make the impact Wisconsin needs.
[That's why we're asking you to step up today. We can't let WI's court fall to MAGA extremists. * * *
# **Conservative state financial officers pledge to partner with Trump 's "War on Fraud" after uncovering $28 billion in waste**
The State Financial Officers Foundation (SFOF), representing 40 conservative state treasurers, auditors and comptrollers across 28 states who oversee more than $3 trillion in state funds, **[sent a letter to Vice President JD Vance pledging to support the Trump administration's anti-fraud mission](https://substack.com/redirect/7988c173-1003-47ce-a5ad-d6d65238a589?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after their inaugural 2025 Oversight Report claimed members safeguarded more than $28 billion in waste, fraud, and abuse in 2025 alone.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7988c173-1003-47ce-a5ad-d6d65238a589?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The report highlights egregious examples including Florida Chief Financial Officer Blaise Ingoglia finding just under $2 billion in excessive spending, Kentucky Auditor Allison Ball discovering more than $836 million in improper Medicaid payments, North Carolina State Auditor Dave Boliek uncovering over $1 billion in lapsed salaries from long-term vacancies, and Utah Auditor Tina Cannon identifying more than $518 million in fraud across agencies and nonprofits receiving state and federal funds.
* **What 's next:** SFOF CEO OJ Oleka told Vance the group's members are "allies already on the battlefield" ready to assist the administration in protecting taxpayer dollars through a coordinated federal-state approach. The partnership comes as Vance announced Wednesday the administration has "decided to temporarily halt certain amounts of Medicaid funding" to Minnesota to ensure the state "takes its obligations seriously to be good stewards of the American people's tax money" following a massive Medicaid fraud scandal.

* * *
# **Megyn Kelly shares 1999 photo claiming Bill Clinton ogled her friend hours before Epstein testimony**
Megyn Kelly shared a decades-old photo from 1999 on her show Thursday claiming **[it shows then-President Bill Clinton"looking down the chest" of her friend](https://substack.com/redirect/18f42f7c-ce48-4b07-832e-1c3efe2fb560?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at the Bombay Club in Washington, DC, just hours before Clinton is scheduled to testify Friday before the House Oversight Committee about his association with late pedophile Jeffrey Epstein.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/51433e26-03ff-4c3d-aa2a-9e89a52f1847?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **What Kelly said:** "Bill was not shamed at all -- after the Monica Lewinsky scandal -- out of his hound dog behavior, to put it mildly," Kelly said, alleging Clinton "basically got his hand on her side boob" and brazenly posed for the photo in the middle of the restaurant while his wife Hillary and daughter Chelsea were present. She stressed "I'm not saying this is a crime" but claimed it showed Clinton "was not chastised at all as a result of Lewinsky."
* **The backdrop:** Clinton is expected to give a deposition Friday over his history with Epstein and the late pedophile's madam Ghislaine Maxwell. Clinton has previously admitted having a friendship with Epstein in the late 1990s and early 2000s, flew on Epstein's private jet dozens of times, and has been pictured in the Epstein files, but denies ever visiting Epstein's infamous private island and has long denied any knowledge of Epstein's crimes. Clinton has not been accused of any wrongdoing, and his spokesperson did not immediately respond to Kelly's claims.

* * *
# **Gavin Newsom tells Jen Psaki that VP JD Vance "scares" him "almost more than Trump" as potential 2028 MAGA heir**
California Gov. Gavin Newsom admitted Wednesday on MS NOW that **[Vice President JD Vance worries him"almost more than" President Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/7e5eb9a8-cc1e-41d7-a686-fd2a05523e6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the potential heir to lead the MAGA movement into the 2028 presidential election, calling Vance "a unique fraud and phony" who is "a little more dangerous" with "a nihilism to the way they talk about the world."

@GavinNewsom
Marco Rubio is a complete fraud. But no one tops JD Vance. Talk about a guy who put a mask on his face and grew into it. Pathetic.

* **What Newsom said:** The Democratic governor told former White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki that he "literally" knows Vance and his funders personally, complaining that Vance -- along with Secretary of State Marco Rubio (whom he called "a complete fraud") and Sen. Lindsey Graham -- had been "effective" critics of Trump before coming around to his way of thinking. "Talk about a guy who put a mask on and his face grew into it," Newsom said of Vance.
* **The 2028 speculation:** Newsom suggested Trump might "try to run this out until right after the end, until he can pick and choose who goes behind him," adding "God forbid, we don't take back the House of Representatives, he may be on that ballot," referring to a potential third term. Trump has repeatedly said he will not seek a third term and has demurred on who should replace him, only saying that either Vance or Rubio would be a good choice while touting both their skills.

| | | | | | Hi –
**Today is the last day of early voting!****Polls are open from 7am to 7pm, and you can find more info at****www.vote411.org**
These last two weeks I’ve been busy hitting the pavement and talking to voters all day every day!! Thanks to your generous support, we’ve reached over 20,000 voters (and their pets!) in TX-21 through block-walking, phone-banking, and mail pieces to spread our message and continue building momentum to win our primary outright!
---
|
---
| | One of my goals with voter outreach is educating constituents who have been moved into our district under [the new Texas maps](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=1a65a586e5&e=395a33a3d2). It’s a shame that our state didn’t bother to tell these folks before they hit the polls, so I’ve been busy spreading the word - which they’ve been grateful for!
Conversations at the doors have been a mix between despair and hope. Everyone is concerned about what Trump is doing to our country with no guardrails. Before running, I worked in congressional oversight - at the GAO and in the U.S. Senate - so I’m ready to demand accountability and justice!
What’s giving people hope is seeing people head to the polls in droves! I saw our state Democratic chair Kendall Scudder last night in Blanco, and he said we hit over 1,000,000 Democratic primary voters yesterday. People are fired up!
To be sure, these are not all Democrats! [I met a Republican on the street this week who told me he voted for me - it was the first time in his life he’d ever voted in the Democratic primary](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=168cdeb319&e=395a33a3d2)!
---

Just five days away now to the primary - let’s win this!!

All of that is to say, I know all the emails Governor Shapiro and the team send out can blur together sometimes. So I wanted to use this opportunity to run through exactly where our campaign stands right now:

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The Left was out of control at Berkeley
body:
[Mark as Spam](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?xul=4cscvssgesax5z7odbg0fo8cpoxze5c7rqq9tmgl3frv81gakkean8dmp8eumcm4lhnjn02828v9zarxt8xhjqzg50yjxezu3ybyr9voniak99l&__stmp=tb4k4a&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh) | [Unsubscribe](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?xul=4cscvssgesax5z7odbg0fo8cpoxze5c7rqq9tmgl3frv81gakkean8dmp8eumcm4lhnjn02828v9zarxt8xhjqzg50yjxezu3ybyr9voniak99l&__stmp=tb4k4a&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
* * *
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, They tried to break us. At UC Berkeley — one of the most hostile, left-wing campuses in America — ANTIFA tried to shut down our final campus tour stop of 2025. They showed up hours early. Wearing masks. Lighting flares and smoke bombs. Throwing paint and glass bottles at attendees. Waving Mexican and rainbow flags. They mocked Charlie's assassination... pointing to their own necks where he was shot. They chanted: _"F*** Charlie Kirk"... "No safe space for fascist scum"... "Fascists out of Berkeley."_ And they rushed police barricades, hoping to break through and disrupt our final campus tour stop of the semester.
---
[](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)
---
ANTIFA surrounded the venue, blocking every entrance. Even after our students and attendees were leaving, ANTIFA located their exit and continued to meet them with violence. The mob swarmed every student, speaker, and parent who came to hear a message of faith, family, and freedom. A mother holding her two daughters was forced to push through a wall of protesters screaming profanity in her children's faces. Another attendee, blood dripping from his brow, was pulled to safety after being struck in the chaos outside the event. These out-of-control Leftists weren't satisfied with merely being heard in protest — _They wanted to pick a fight._ Police made multiple arrests. **UC Berkeley, a so-called "bastion" of free speech, turned into a war zone.**
---
| | [](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)
---
But still... The event went on. A packed house. Our students didn't retreat. They stood strong. Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie's legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: **Truth is louder than hate.**
---
[](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)
---
| | **Friend, I need you to hear this next part — because it's about patriots like you.** This tour? This fight? These students who keep showing up — even when it's dangerous? They didn't get here on their own. They got here because patriots like YOU believed in them. Because when the mobs swarmed... When the threats came in... When everyone from the fake news media to the so-called political "experts" said Gen Z was lost to the Left... And when they tried to silence this movement that Charlie built... People like you stood up. Stayed in. Kept the mission alive. And showed our young people that they're not alone. That America is still worth fighting for. That free speech still has defenders. That faith, family, and FREEDOM still have a future. So if you've ever wondered if it's working... If it's worth it... **Let me be clear: Patriots like you are why we're winning the American Culture War.** And now this is your chance to be part of something rare — a moment in history where patriotic young Americans are reclaiming the culture, one campus at a time. Our students on campus are truly the vanguard for saving this nation, but they need to know we have their backs. **Will you make a gift right now to send backup to the frontlines and stand with these young patriots who refuse to quit?** **[Every dollar you give today helps us protect our student leaders, send activism kits to chapters, defend free speech, and fuel our reach to change more hearts and minds.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Send Backup to the Frontlines**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)
---
The Left tried to intimidate us. They tried to outnumber us. They tried to drown us out. But we didn't blink. Our students didn't blink. The mob at Berkeley couldn't stop us. _Because we didn't come to Berkeley to be liked..._ **We came to speak truth.** We came to finish what Charlie started. That's exactly what happened. **And that's exactly why we're winning.** Friend, thank you. Patriots like you helped turn chaos into courage... Hate into hope... And grief into grit. Let's keep going...
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)

When they mocked Charlie's murder... Our students held the line. If you believe in what they're doing... If you know this fight is just beginning... Your support means more than you know. [**You can help by sending backup to the frontlines. Help these brave young leaders fight for freedom and equip our student chapters across the country.**](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4k4a&__onlt=h)

The Atlantic: Donald Trump’s Plan to Subvert the Midterms Is Already Under Way [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022726_1&amount=25]
Team, that headline from The Atlantic says it all.
Donald Trump already promised as part of his 2024 campaign that “we’ll have it fixed so good, you’re not gonna have to vote .” Watching his actions after he lost in 2020 -- lies, denial, rallies, all leading to January 6th -- it's not hard to imagine what he's got in mind for November.
Our states run our elections. But that doesn't mean that MAGA-aligned politicians won't follow his illegal orders to interfere. It doesn't stop him from using ICE agents to intimidate at the polls or threaten eligible voters. And it doesn't stop his Department of Justice from trying to interfere through the courts, especially when more than half of the suppressive lawsuits brought to court this year were brought by the very federal department that's supposed to protect our rights.
None of that takes into account the highly partisan efforts for mid-decade redistricting as well. It's clear that the threats to the next election aren't going to stop. That's where we come in.
We must inform voters, defend our elections, and make sure every eligible vote counts. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to fuel our voting rights work for 2026 and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022726_1&amount=35]

Our democracy, our elections, and our fundamental right to vote have been under attack for more than a decade. Our electoral system is reaching a breaking point, and it's hard to predict exactly where the next set of electoral shenanigans will come from.

subject: News from First Lady Dawn Moore
body:
| | | | Hello Friends and Fellow Marylanders, In the first two months of the year, our administration has moved fast and with intention to deliver results for the people of Maryland. We know that in order to find solutions, we must work together by bringing all Marylanders to the table to make an impact. In this newsletter, you see partnership in action. We've uplifted the accomplishments of our young students in Prince George’s County, welcomed Buddhist monks during their “Walk for Peace” in Annapolis, reaffirmed our commitment to the arts in Baltimore, and invited hundreds of Marylanders to engage in conversation and celebration in Government House. And under the leadership of my husband, Governor Wes Moore, we introduced a balanced budget and a legislative agenda focused on the issues that Marylanders care about most: public education, safe communities, lower housing costs, and Maryland’s economic competitiveness. I ask all Marylanders to continue to join us on the mission to uplift our communities and “leave no one behind.” Take Care, **First Lady Dawn Moore** |
* * *
---
## **KEEPING UP WITH**
# **THE FIRST LADY**
### [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Launches-Third-Maryland-Corps-and-Service-Year-Option-Cohort-During-911-Day-of-Service-and-Remembrance.aspx/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/xESYDvdVhArVDjTk-D1S4uszjmS53c-gaG3UwzuF6-E=446)[First Lady Moore Celebrates Prince George’s County School as National Winner of Creative Freedom Campaign](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.pgcps.org%2Foffices%2Fcommunications-and-community-engagement%2Fnewsroom%2Fnews%2Fnewsroom-archives%2F2025---2026%2Fpress-release-kettering-middle-school-celebrates-historic-selection-as-national-winner-of-crayola-creative-freedom-campaign/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/cQIU17WlsHcIwPKig1WfGxklESJ4rcqerOHabpdStPc=446)
The First Lady traveled to Prince George’s County to celebrate Kettering Middle School winning the “Creative Freedom Campaign.” A partnership between the [Foundation for Art and Preservation in Embassies (FAPE)](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Ffapeculturaldiplomacy.org%2F/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/NLWOLpqqA3lAeo4xZ76JNKvBbuBnFxqJFPRIcHsVO64=446) and [Crayola Learning](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.crayola.com%2F/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/R5iLbPG_WkKImnsGLBkpfGfDOwkrcwUgI6HyoSUvZfM=446), the initiative selected Kettering as one of only three public schools in the nation and the only middle school in Maryland—to receive this prestigious honor.
As part of the award and in honor of America’s 250th celebration, Kettering received a museum-quality replica of the Declaration of Independence, along with original artworks on loan from FAPE.
First Lady Moore was joined by nearly 100 students and faculty, County Executive Aisha Braveboy, and local elected and school officials. Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist Eugene Robinson delivered remarks, and renowned Puerto Rican American artist and activist Roberto Lugo performed spoken word.
During the event, the first lady highlighted the administration’s commitment to building a world-class education system, with record funding in education and investments to improve educator training, teacher vacancy rates, and literacy and math performance among students.
* * *
---
### [Governor and First Lady Moore and Lt. Governor Miller Host Monks on “Walk For Peace” at Government House](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fleadership%2Fltgovernor%2Fnews%2Fpages%2FLieutenant-Governor-Welcomes-Monks.aspx/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/Z76nZgIa1uBGmnEef9riW4wn8vG3RgktqP99SjVDP5Q=446)
Under the leadership of Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller, nearly two dozen Buddhist monks traveled to Annapolis for the final destination on their “Walk for Peace.” The Governor and First Lady invited the monks, dozens of volunteers, and their canine companion, Aloka to lunch – marking the first time the monks have visited an official residence of a First Family along their journey.
Upwards of 12,000 people welcomed the monks to Annapolis. Following brief remarks in front of the State House, the monks were introduced to the House and Senate Chambers and presented with resolutions.
During the private lunch, Governor Moore presented them with Maryland State Flags pins to commemorate their visit and thank them for their commitment to compassion and peace.
Click [here](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.flickr.com%2Fphotos%2Fmdgovpics%2Falbums%2F72177720331996311%2F/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/irObxlZNuLZCOqXyUuXdUQoYeOhpmHBhJp8wp8FB68g=446) for more photos from this historic day.
* * *
---
| [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fnews.maryland.gov%2Fmsde%2Fmontgomery-county-schools-with-state-superintendent%2F/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/dRgzhoCr5ShXrwzanDKf0EQbZkWvzC4z045d94Z4Mco=446)**[First Lady Moore Uplifts Arts Community during MICA Bicentennial Celebration](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.mica.edu%2Fart-articles%2Fdetails%2Fmica-launches-new-strategic-initiatives-for-the-bicentennial-year%2F/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/z1qLOqG8pgKGJx42lBg2SN9XUs-7tvaTxWW--kbivuw=446)** As a fierce champion of the arts, First Lady Moore was honored to deliver remarks at the bicentennial celebration of the[ Maryland Institute College of Art (MICA)](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.mica.edu%2F/1/0100019c9fde12a3-cf773994-bf24-4ac2-84c6-fba809e53312-000000/BQuTntT6MD741RJ7HKzRWXqxi4y0_vdd3MEkvQ3-ca8=446), the nation’s oldest continuous degree-granting college of art and design. She was joined by MICA President Cecilia McCormick, elected officials, esteemed alumni including artist Derrick Adams, and MICA faculty, staff, and students. The First Lady highlighted the state’s investment in MICA’s initiatives, and our goal to increase funding to $30 million in the FY27 budget for the Maryland State Arts Council that proudly supports more than 350 local arts organizations.

The First Lady also spoke about her work supporting military families, improving children’s mental health, advancing women’s economic empowerment, and expanding access to the arts.

clean_body: | | | | Hello Friends and Fellow Marylanders, In the first two months of the year, our administration has moved fast and with intention to deliver results for the people of Maryland. We know that in order to find solutions, we must work together by bringing all Marylanders to the table to make an impact. In this newsletter, you see partnership in action. We've uplifted the accomplishments of our young students in Prince George’s County, welcomed Buddhist monks during their “Walk for Peace” in Annapolis, reaffirmed our commitment to the arts in Baltimore, and invited hundreds of Marylanders to engage in conversation and celebration in Government House. And under the leadership of my husband, Governor Wes Moore, we introduced a balanced budget and a legislative agenda focused on the issues that Marylanders care about most: public education, safe communities, lower housing costs, and Maryland’s economic competitiveness. I ask all Marylanders to continue to join us on the mission to uplift our communities and “leave no one behind.” Take Care, First Lady Dawn Moore | KEEPING UP WITH THE FIRST LADY The First Lady traveled to Prince George’s County to celebrate Kettering Middle School winning the “Creative Freedom Campaign.” A partnership between the and , the initiative selected Kettering as one of only three public schools in the nation and the only middle school in Maryland—to receive this prestigious honor. As part of the award and in honor of America’s 250th celebration, Kettering received a museum-quality replica of the Declaration of Independence, along with original artworks on loan from FAPE. First Lady Moore was joined by nearly 100 students and faculty, County Executive Aisha Braveboy, and local elected and school officials. Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist Eugene Robinson delivered remarks, and renowned Puerto Rican American artist and activist Roberto Lugo performed spoken word. During the event, the first lady highlighted the administration’s commitment to building a world-class education system, with record funding in education and investments to improve educator training, teacher vacancy rates, and literacy and math performance among students. Under the leadership of Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller, nearly two dozen Buddhist monks traveled to Annapolis for the final destination on their “Walk for Peace.” The Governor and First Lady invited the monks, dozens of volunteers, and their canine companion, Aloka to lunch – marking the first time the monks have visited an official residence of a First Family along their journey. Upwards of 12,000 people welcomed the monks to Annapolis. Following brief remarks in front of the State House, the monks were introduced to the House and Senate Chambers and presented with resolutions. During the private lunch, Governor Moore presented them with Maryland State Flags pins to commemorate their visit and thank them for their commitment to compassion and peace. name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: They tried to cancel us with chaos. It didn't work.
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmb8icvorwpij54j5gxi00fqr04qenksw61900xhs3k6t2l2g0crps6npg5dwph6hfpsv1ediwhk6iecwb4yk0i6m8kxjgsd8h6wrhjr&__stmp=tb4kyb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor
* * *

| | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, They tried to break us. At UC Berkeley — one of the most hostile, left-wing campuses in America — ANTIFA tried to shut down our final campus tour stop of 2025. They showed up hours early. Wearing masks. Lighting flares and smoke bombs. Throwing paint and glass bottles at attendees. Waving Mexican and rainbow flags. They mocked Charlie's assassination... pointing to their own necks where he was shot. They chanted: _"F*** Charlie Kirk"... "No safe space for fascist scum"... "Fascists out of Berkeley."_ And they rushed police barricades, hoping to break through and disrupt our final campus tour stop of the semester.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)
---
ANTIFA surrounded the venue, blocking every entrance. Even after our students and attendees were leaving, ANTIFA located their exit and continued to meet them with violence. The mob swarmed every student, speaker, and parent who came to hear a message of faith, family, and freedom. A mother holding her two daughters was forced to push through a wall of protesters screaming profanity in her children's faces. Another attendee, blood dripping from his brow, was pulled to safety after being struck in the chaos outside the event. These out-of-control Leftists weren't satisfied with merely being heard in protest — _They wanted to pick a fight._ Police made multiple arrests. **UC Berkeley, a so-called "bastion" of free speech, turned into a war zone.**
---
| | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)
---
But still... The event went on. A packed house. Our students didn't retreat. They stood strong. Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie's legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: **Truth is louder than hate.**
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)
---
| | **Friend, I need you to hear this next part — because it's about patriots like you.** This tour? This fight? These students who keep showing up — even when it's dangerous? They didn't get here on their own. They got here because patriots like YOU believed in them. Because when the mobs swarmed... When the threats came in... When everyone from the fake news media to the so-called political "experts" said Gen Z was lost to the Left... And when they tried to silence this movement that Charlie built... People like you stood up. Stayed in. Kept the mission alive. And showed our young people that they're not alone. That America is still worth fighting for. That free speech still has defenders. That faith, family, and FREEDOM still have a future. So if you've ever wondered if it's working... If it's worth it... **Let me be clear: Patriots like you are why we're winning the American Culture War.** And now this is your chance to be part of something rare — a moment in history where patriotic young Americans are reclaiming the culture, one campus at a time. Our students on campus are truly the vanguard for saving this nation, but they need to know we have their backs. **Will you make a gift right now to send backup to the frontlines and stand with these young patriots who refuse to quit?** **[Every dollar you give today helps us protect our student leaders, send activism kits to chapters, defend free speech, and fuel our reach to change more hearts and minds.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Send Backup to the Frontlines**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)
---
The Left tried to intimidate us. They tried to outnumber us. They tried to drown us out. But we didn't blink. Our students didn't blink. The mob at Berkeley couldn't stop us. _Because we didn't come to Berkeley to be liked..._ **We came to speak truth.** We came to finish what Charlie started. That's exactly what happened. **And that's exactly why we're winning.** Friend, thank you. Patriots like you helped turn chaos into courage... Hate into hope... And grief into grit. Let's keep going...
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)

When they mocked Charlie's murder... Our students held the line. If you believe in what they're doing... If you know this fight is just beginning... Your support means more than you know. [**You can help by sending backup to the frontlines. Help these brave young leaders fight for freedom and equip our student chapters across the country.**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb4kyb&__onlt=h)

Jerri Green is the only candidate with the common sense, compassion, and courage to make that vision a reality. We’ve already seen what Trump Republicans have in store for us, and Marsha Blackburn is just more of the same –loud talk and failed policies that are hurting hardworking Tennesseans. We’re fighting for a brighter future that every Tennessean can be proud of. It looks like: No Tennesseans having to travel more than 30 minutes t o make it to an emergency room Expanding Medicaid, especially in rural areas, and respecting a woman's ability to make her own decisions regarding her healthcare A world class education for our kids because schools are fully staffed and funded, our teachers are supported, and kids aren’t hungry in the classroom Thriving families who can afford to put food on the table. Paid family leave and not having to choose between a good paying job and childcare. All over Tennessee, we hear the same thing: people are ready for a government that actually sees them. Real change starts with a vision of a future worth fighting for. We’ve got the vision, and with your support,we will see it through. We’ve set a goal to raise $12,108 by MIDNIGHT tomorrow. | | , This afternoon I’ll be with the University of Texas Democrats at the polls from 3 to 7 p.m. at the Flawn Academic Center in the heart of the UT campus. **I’m proud to stand shoulder to shoulder with these students.** They endorsed me because I stood firmly on the side of free expression on campus. And I always will. As you now probably know, I believe every Texas high school senior should graduate registered and ready to vote. That simple step builds lifelong civic engagement. It creates leaders. **It strengthens democracy.** That is why the UT Democrats’ endorsement means so much to me. These student leaders represent the very best of young Texans who are ready to shape their future. They, along with student organizations across Texas, have endorsed this campaign because I have made it clear that if elected, I will dedicate my four-year term to helping young Texans afford the American Dream. **But at the heart of everything is this: their right to vote and their right to speak.** When students exercised their First Amendment rights to protest on campus, the Legislature passed SB 2972, the so-called Campus Security Act, to suppress campus speech. My opponent Nathan Johnson supported that bill. The UT administration enforced it harshly. The students went to court and won. Ken Paxton has appealed that ruling. That tells you everything you need to know about where he stands. I know where I stand. I stand with the students. Now and forever. **Young Texans deserve an Attorney General who will defend their constitutional rights, not undermine them.** Who will expand participation, not suppress it. Who understands that democracy grows stronger when students are engaged, not silenced. If you are on campus this afternoon, come say hello. If you are voting today, thank you. If you have not voted yet, make your plan now. Onward to the polls!

**

body:

Folks, is there _anything_ we can say to earn your support today?
**What if we told you our extreme opponent is backed by the same right-wing special interests that have tried to buy Wisconsin’s Supreme Court before?**
Even former GOP Gov. Scott Walker is working to boost our opponent’s campaign.
**What if we told you this election is in April — not November — and many Wisconsinites still don’t realize it’s happening?**
Getting the word out costs money, and time is running out to pool together the resources we need.
**What if we told you that this race could determine the future of reproductive healthcare access, workers’ rights, and whether our courts protect our freedoms or undermine them?**
It’s true. Whoever wins this election will sit on the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a _decade,_ and the fundraising window to prepare for April is closing fast.
**Finally, what if we told you that even $10 makes a difference?** When you chip in, another person does too, and together, we’re able to build a movement capable of winning.
[**With all of that in mind, can you donate $10 today to elect Judge Chris Taylor and protect Wisconsin’s Supreme Court?**](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260227_1_ak.FMERyQ&amount=10&refcode=em20260227-1171&t=3&akid=1173%2E294397%2EMdkw5S)

| Peter, Welcome to the latest edition of Emily’s Notes, updates from Washington’s 6th District and Washington, D.C.! Here's what I've been up to: **• 18 million reasons to celebrate** — I’m proud to announce that we’ve secured $17.9 million in funds for community projects in every county of the 6th District! These projects range from housing and health care to transportation and climate resilience. [_**See an interactive map of the projects here →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126269527/604432546/-509906286?mid=1mFkmH2DbRY0k9o0B1JvVh1IQ1ofxzm4&ll=47.71833880816157%2C-123.20298174448044&z=8&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.02.27_FebNewsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmZmMDI1Mi1mOTEzLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zg6qVsEzNz0svlz2b9EdAP3BNAZxud1pMrsLWv6Ao24=&emci=38e4fdb9-f313-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=d6ff0252-f913-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=23483442) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126269528/604432548/-584968000?mid=1mFkmH2DbRY0k9o0B1JvVh1IQ1ofxzm4&ll=47.71833880816157%2C-123.20298174448044&z=8&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.02.27_FebNewsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmZmMDI1Mi1mOTEzLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zg6qVsEzNz0svlz2b9EdAP3BNAZxud1pMrsLWv6Ao24=&emci=38e4fdb9-f313-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=d6ff0252-f913-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=23483442) **• The state of the 6th** — Instead of attending Trump’s State of the Union address, I hosted a “State of the 6th” livestream to discuss issues facing the district. I’m so glad that Thurston County Commissioner Wayne Fournier was in D.C. and able to join the town hall! [_**You can watch the full recording here →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126269530/604432549/-1451214379?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.02.27_FebNewsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmZmMDI1Mi1mOTEzLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2E1NzU5M2YiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zg6qVsEzNz0svlz2b9EdAP3BNAZxud1pMrsLWv6Ao24=&emci=38e4fdb9-f313-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&emdi=d6ff0252-f913-f111-a69a-000d3a57593f&ceid=23483442) **• They were here first** — I’ve heard from Tribal leaders in my district that ICE and CBP agents are stopping and questioning their members, and that those agents often don’t recognize their Tribal IDs.

body:
Big things are happening in New Hampshire, and the spirit of "Live Free or Die" is stronger than ever in Concord!

| | | | | [|
---](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=b944d067cb&e=8c8e704ee6)
| | | | | | Peter,

**Big things are happening in New Hampshire, and the spirit of "**_**Live Free or Die**_**" is stronger than ever in Concord!**

With our 95 Pledge Champions leading the way, we are seeing real progress on issues that protect individual freedoms, empower families, and push back against government overreach.

Here are the latest updates on key bills where our Pledge Champions are making a difference:

**HB 1793: Protecting College Students Act**

HB 1793 removes dangerous "gun-free zones" on public college and university campuses by prohibiting restrictions on the possession, carry, or storage of firearms and non-lethal weapons such as tasers or pepper spray.

The bill includes strong enforcement with up to $10,000 in statutory damages for violations, ensuring institutions respect Second Amendment rights.

**Where it stands** : The bill passed the House and has been referred to the Senate Judiciary Committee. A public hearing is expected soon, positioning it for potential Senate passage and a signature from the Governor.

**Prime Sponsor** : Rep. Samuel Farrington (R-Straf. 8)

Send Rep. Farrington an email to thank him for fighting for our Second Amendment rights! [Samuel.Farrington@gc.nh.gov](mailto:Samuel.Farrington@gc.nh.gov)

**HB 1268: The Home Education Freedom Act – Setting the Standard for the Nation

**HB 1268 is a fantastic bill poised to make our state the best in the nation, allowing a parent to take full control of their child's education by removing unnecessary regulations and restoring parental control over home education.

The bill makes initial notifications and annual evaluations optional, ends district micromanagement, protects families from paperwork misuse in truancy or welfare cases, and clearly separates traditional home education from publicly funded Education Freedom Accounts.

**Where it stands** : After a public hearing last week, the bill is headed to Executive Session in the House Education Policy and Administration Committee on Monday, March 2nd. Amendments are being finalized that would solidify New Hampshire's leadership in home education freedom.

**Prime Sponsor** : Rep. Kristin Noble (R-Hills. 2)

Reach out to Rep. Noble and thank her for her hard work and for fighting for Education Freedom! [Kristin.Noble@gc.nh.gov](mailto:Kristin.Noble@gc.nh.gov)

**CACR 24: Locking Parental Rights into the New Hampshire Constitution

** CACR 24 proposes a constitutional amendment to enshrine the fundamental right of parents and guardians to direct their children's upbringing and education.

This would provide lasting protection against future attempts to increase regulations and give families stronger legal safeguards. While HB 1268 is a fantastic move for educational freedom, placing CACR 24 in our constitution further solidifies New Hampshire's commitment to protecting a parent or guardian's right to decide what is right for their child and family against a hostile government.

**Where it stands** : CACR 24 had its public hearing last week, and is scheduled for Executive Session in the House Education Policy and Administration Committee on Monday, March 2. If it passes both chambers with a three-fifths majority, it will go to voters in November 2026 for final approval.

**Prime Sponsor** : Rep. Michael Granger (R-Straf. 2)

Send Rep. Granger an email thanking him for his fight to lock parental rights into the New Hampshire Constitution! [Michael.Granger@gc.nh.gov](mailto:Michael.Granger@gc.nh.gov)

**HB 1706: Opting Out of Federal Refugee Resettlement Programs

** HB 1704 repeals New Hampshire's refugee resettlement program and prohibits the use of state funds to support it. This measure reclaims state sovereignty, prevents federal imposition of resettlement without local consent, and protects resources for Granite Staters amid ongoing concerns about housing, schools, and services.

**Where it stands** : A public hearing was held on Tuesday, and the bill is due out of committee by March 5. This is a major effort right now, with strong momentum building.

**Prime Sponsor** : Rep. Travis Corcoran (R-Weare)

Thank Rep. Corcoran for standing firm on limited government and state sovereignty by sending him an email today! [tjic2020@gmail.com](mailto:tjic2020@gmail.com)

We will keep you updated on the movement of these bills and more legislation that reclaims our freedoms!

For New Hampshire,

body:
Rick Green praises Trey's intellect & professionalism after decades of knowing him—early voting ends TODAY. Get to the polls!

| | | | | [|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=efc54a3df4&e=4d3fe76c62)
| | Peter,
Today is the **last day of early voting** and with the **March 3, 2026** primary just days away, I'm thrilled to share some powerful momentum in our campaign.
[**Rick Green**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=a78d998317&e=4d3fe76c62), America's Constitution Coach and Founder of Patriot Academy, and a respected voice for constitutional conservatism across Texas has **publicly endorsed** me for Congress in TX-21.
---
[|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=298791c312&e=4d3fe76c62)
| | On February16th, Rick wrote the following on his [Facebook](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=68ae7674eb&e=4d3fe76c62) page:
_"I have lots of friends in this race and as mentioned above, I think Chip Roy is great, so I cannot endorse any candidate that was already running against Chip before he moved to the AG race. While there are lots of good people in this race and I happen to be a major baseball fan, my vote is going to**TREY TRAINOR** who I have known for decades and always admired his intellect, professionalism, and grasp of the issues."_
This endorsement from Rick means a great deal. For decades, he's educated thousands on our founding principles, trained the next generation of conservative leaders through Patriot Academy, and stood firmly for faith, family, and freedom. His long personal knowledge of me affirms exactly why I'm running: to bring principled, experienced conservative leadership to Washington.
This announcement brings our total to **26 endorsements** this primary cycle—from grassroots leaders, conservative organizations, and trusted voices who know TX-21 needs a proven fighter aligned with President Trump's America First agenda.
**We don't need more politicians learning on the job**. As the only candidate who's worked directly with President Trump since 2016, led a federal agency through DOGE efficiency cuts, and battled the DC swamp on election integrity and conservative values, I'm ready to hit the ground running for secure borders, economic strength, government accountability, and the principles Rick Green has championed for years.
**Today is your last chance to vote early**. Head to your polling location before it closes tonight! If you've already voted, thank you! Now encourage friends, family, and neighbors who haven't to get out and [**support**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=d17cea0086&e=4d3fe76c62)**Trey Trainor**.
This crowded primary will be decided by committed conservatives like you. Let's send a strong, reliable ally to Congress who will fight every day for TX-21 and America First.
For our shared values and for Texas,
**Trey Trainor** Husband, Father of 6,Proven Conservative for TX-21

name: Alycia R. Gruenhagen | U.S. Senate 2026
subject: Don't Let Familiarity Blind Us to What's Possible
body:
Fellow Minnesotan to Fellow Minnesotan.

| | | | | [|
---](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=d2ad3bbf54&e=49d94faf06)
| | | | [|
---](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=795d6644ea&e=49d94faf06)
| | **This Moment Matters - Familiarity, Minnesota Roots, and the Moment Before Us**

---
| |

Friends,
There’s an old saying: familiarity breeds contempt.
In small-town rural Minnesota, I’ve seen how that plays out. When you grow up with someone—when they’re the neighbor kid, the familiar face at the local store, or “the girl down the road”—it’s easy to take their strengths for granted. We get so used to the steady, reliable people around us that we sometimes forget to pause and appreciate just how valuable those qualities really are.
I was raised with the small-town values we all recognize: loyalty to family, respect for neighbors, keeping your word, and showing up when it matters. Those principles have guided my life. I’ve built lifelong friendships here, and I’m always open to making new ones. I strive to stay approachable, down-to-earth, and genuine. I listen more than I talk, and I believe trust is earned through actions, not announcements.
What I’ve learned is that the most dependable leaders often come from exactly these roots. They don’t need flash or ego to get things done—they bring consistency, integrity, and a genuine heart for the people they serve.
Minnesota has an incredible opportunity in 2026. With the U.S. Senate seat open, we can choose representation that feels like us: steady, fair, honest, and deeply connected to the real lives of families across our state—whether in Glencoe, Maple Grove, the Iron Range, or the Twin Cities.
Both parties talk about serving everyday people, but right now [**we have a President in who is making it real**](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=4d13cfcf7c&e=49d94faf06)**.** We have the opportunity to flip this seat, to elevate leaders who reflect our values, who understand our challenges, and who will fight for all Minnesotans without self-interest getting in the way.
This campaign is about more than any one person—it’s about recognizing and choosing the kind of leadership our state deserves. Leadership grounded in character, not headlines. So take a fresh look at what really matters. Look at the values. Look at the commitment to this state and its people.
**Let’s seize this moment to bring strong, principled representation to Washington -- to support President Donald J. TRUMP in his endeavor to Make America Great.** Help flip Minnesota red and deliver the change we need.
If this resonates with you, please let me know—[**share this email with friends**](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=485159f825&e=49d94faf06), [make a donation if you’re able, or drop me a message, text, or social media note.](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=b5a6c9e560&e=49d94faf06) Tell me how you’d like to get involved. Together, we can flip this state to common sense leadership.
With gratitude and determination,
Alycia R. Gruenhagen **Candidate for U.S. Senate, Minnesota** Glencoe, MN **www.alycia4senate.com** Proudly representing OUR SHARED Minnesota values.

The address was pitch perfect--maybe his best speech ever.

subject: The Work Continues — And So Do We

body:

Friends —
Across the country, momentum is building.
Women continue to step forward —some for the very first time, others already on the path to the ballot—and Emerge is helping make it possible.
Beyond Emerge’s Signature Training and Boot Camps, which boast a more than 70% candidate win rate, we offer so much more. For many women who know they want to step into leadership but may not be ready to take the plunge into elected office, Emerge steps in to guide women on their path. In the past year alone, we’ve reached thousands of women nationwide and coached more than 600 women through our programs, partnerships, and national initiatives like Women Talk Politics Day.
From there, that interest turns into action. Through Emerge Rising , women are moving from civic engagement to leadership—serving on boards and commissions and beginning to chart a path toward running for office.
At the same time, we’re building leadership before campaigns even begin. In Leaders Emerge , participants are defining their voice, values, and vision—laying the groundwork for the leaders they will become.
And for some, that path is already leading to the ballot. Through our Gavel In program, Emerge is training women to run for judicial seats— 125 of whom are now sitting on benches across the country.
This work is also intentionally expanding access. We trained in Mississippi and North Carolina through nonpartisan programs, hundreds of women through Divine Nine partnerships , and women nationwide across the State of the People Power Tour —reaching communities that have too often been left out of the political process.
This is what building power actually looks like—step by step, program by program, woman by woman.
And we’re just getting started.
In 2026, Emerge will expand this work further—training more women, launching new programs such as our School Board initiative, and continuing to invest in the New American Majority across the country.
If we’re going to meet this moment, we need to scale this work.
Will you contribute today to help us train the next generation of women leaders?
Because leadership doesn’t start on Election Day, it starts right now—with women deciding to step forward.
— A’shanti

body:
Hi friends — quick update on the situation with Trump’s tariffs.
The Supreme Court ruled last week that the President’s sweeping global tariffs were an illegal abuse of executive power.
Trump, not to be discouraged in his idiocy, declared within hours that the SCOTUS ruling actually made him stronger (sure...), and that he’d use a different authority to enact new global tariffs.
Then this week, those new tariffs went into effect at 10%. Trump is still threatening to raise them to 15%.
So basically — total chaos. (Exactly what business owners and the stock market thrive on, right??)
Here’s what I want you to know through all this: In Congress, we are working very hard to do two things:
1. Put a stop to these tariffs altogether through legislation and/or through our partners in the courts.
2. Return the billions of dollars of illegally-collected tariffs to American consumers — not just to corporations and CEOs, never to see the light of day again.
Neither of these is an easy task, but we’re not going to stop pushing until we deliver real solutions for the millions of people across the country who are struggling under Trump’s economy.
And of course, one thing that will make it easier to accomplish our goals and deliver results is having a Democratic majority to leverage!
If you can, please pitch in to support my team’s work to flip the House before we close the books on our February fundraising goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Thank you for your partnership! I really appreciate you.
—Sara

Over the past year, 90% of the economic burden of Trump’s tariffs fell on U.S. companies and consumers. Not foreign countries. Not overseas manufacturers. Us!
And the highest court in the country has confirmed that they’re not just bad policy — they’re also an abuse of presidential power and an overreach of the executive branch.
You know things are bad when even THIS Supreme Court says Trump has gone too far...
Trump has claimed that foreign governments are “paying” for his tariffs. But that’s literally not how tariffs work. Tariffs are just taxes on goods that we import from other countries — things like electronics, coffee, cars, furniture, and wine.
These taxes raise costs on the goods we buy, squeeze small businesses, and drive up prices for families who are already struggling to afford housing, child care, health care, and groceries.
And instead of targeting bad actors, Trump slapped pointless tariffs on some of our closest allies — including Canada — making life more expensive for Americans for NO GOOD REASON.
This SCOTUS ruling is a win for the American people, plain and simple (a sentence I never thought I’d say under this Supreme Court...). But we know that with the Trump administration, ideology and ego will continue to replace real economic policy — until we replace our leadership.
The only way to stop these GOP economic failures, bring down costs for Americans, and create more jobs for the long-term is to change who’s in power.
That means electing more Democrats this November. If you can, please contribute today so we can support strong Democrats across the country who will fight back against Trump’s disastrous economic policies. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]

His record of delivering for veterans speaks for itself. As County Executive, David has:
* Helped veterans access VA healthcare and provided grants for those facing financial, health, and housing crises
* Invested $45 million in affordable housing, making sure to include dedicated units for low-income veterans
* Provided funding to **_[Dryhootch](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMSCMskG3hV505_1yVEwmZct0_IM7Vun66TrrKpwcpLV6eElXz6ghLivMKQBU8mMLGe0sRST3AV_ZiPSGknA_-Ywh35TppEdrbAuN34DkwqYyrGwVc_x4rKhCPqRFPCd1b_l5aRZPhRi8r1tSH9DH0cCsy75qrtV0QJIQiaZG79ViCVeS8qkrjJiNKAWAXjIT58ysaQzwpzfg540PMzJFQpAuRr2ocptPFnv8sSspZoy1HGTd6z3lyj2wEIblbpV9hQ/4oi/CruSidN_THKG5cSuTRG2dw/h8/h001.zeSHczer68S29ij0DaKTeq2Jh8r5a4EpocVgu0bf7FA)_** — **our veteran-led nonprofit** offering peer support that saves lives
* Added veterans' benefits specialists to county services
* Invested millions in small businesses, many of them veteran-owned

On the other hand, we know exactly how Tom Tiffany honors Wisconsin's veterans:
* He voted against the PACT Act, which expands VA health care for veterans exposed to toxic substances.
* He voted against the EVEST Act, which would automatically enroll eligible veterans into VA health care.
* He voted against the VA Employee Fairness Act. And when the Veterans Readiness and Employment Improvement Act needed support, he was silent.

# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240717%2E444211%2EeJFZw1)
Something is happening in Texas.
Voter turnout—especially among Democrats—is through the roof.
[__](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260227-1.Ut0zB_&refcode=ema20260227-240717&t=3&akid=240717%2E444211%2EeJFZw1)
The Texas Tribune reports that:
“Through Monday, 665,664 votes were cast in-person and by mail in the Democratic primary, compared to 593,692 cast in the Republican primary, according to unofficial data from the Texas Secretary of State. The 1,259,356 votes is higher than both the 2024 and 2020 primaries through seven days of early voting, despite turnout typically being higher in presidential election years.”
That’s right—more DEMOCRATS are voting in Texas than Republicans, even though this is supposed to be a “red state.”
You might think it has something to do with Jasmine Crockett and James Talarico, two exceptionally exciting candidates, vying for the Democratic nomination for Senate. And you’d be partially right. But you also have to account for the fact that there is an even more competitive and expensive race for the Republican Senate nomination between John Cornyn and Ken Paxton.
So—in a state where Democrats last won a Senate race in 1988, one where Republicans have sought to disenfranchise likely Democratic voters, one that’s not supposed to count—we have the highest voter turnout in memory.
Even my hometown of El Paso is seeing more voters turn out in this primary than when I was running in 2018.
This is happening. Now let’s make the most of it.

Beto

We have a real opportunity to fight back. | | | I wanted to make sure you saw this, Peter. **Earlier this month, we emailed about the Melt ICE Act, legislation that would redirect billions of taxpayer dollars from the DHS to services that would _actually support_ working families. ** The Melt ICE Act presents a real opportunity for us to fight back united and secure a _major win_ for our communities. That’s why United We Dream is getting people organized to support its passage. [**We’re bringing people together to organize, dream, and hold each other accountable to the future we’re building. Peter,
In the face of the terror immigration enforcement is bringing to our communities, we must do what we can to curb their overreach and authority through all avenues, including in Congress.
Congresswoman Delia Ramirez (IL-03) and Congresswoman Yvette Clarke (NY-09) recently introduced the **Melt ICE Act** , a bold piece of legislation that would close all private and public immigrant detention facilities, release all immigrants from detention, and end the violent for-profit electronic monitoring system.
The Melt ICE Act would also redirect _billions_ of taxpayer dollars toward community-based services that support working families — instead of our tax dollars being used to fund death, destruction, and terror across the country.
As families struggle to make ends meet, sometimes working two or three jobs to afford groceries and skyrocketing health care premiums, our money is being pumped into federal agencies and private detention camps that terrorize immigrants and make billionaire CEOs richer.
****
[**United We Dream is mobilizing our communities to demand justice, accountability, and policies that address our needs — work that starts with the Melt ICE Act. Good afternoon! I wanted to briefly catch you during your lunch break.**My name is Kevin Ford, and I’m running to represent you in the Maryland State Senate.**

I grew up around the way, right here in Prince George’s County. I went to school and church here; now my wife and I are raising our two sons in the same community that shaped me. I understand how government works — but more importantly, I understand the pressure families feel, because I feel it too.

I have served as a Delegate to the Democratic National Convention, as an inaugural fellow of Congressman Clyburn’s Leadership Institute, and on Governor Wes Moore’s transition team — where I successfully advocated for the pardon of more than 175,000 Marylanders with non-violent cannabis convictions. I know how to build coalitions and deliver results.

Families today are facing rising costs, our seniors are worried about staying in their homes and too many residents feel disconnected from decisions in Annapolis that directly affect their daily lives.

**This moment demands leadership that is present, accountable, and focused on results.**

My priorities are clear: **Strong Families. Informed Communities. Accountable Governance.**

**Strong Families** require excellence in education, safe communities, and real economic opportunity.

**Informed Communities** demand transparency and year-round civic engagement. Government should not feel distant or confusing. Residents deserve clear communication and real access to their elected officials.

**Accountable Governance** means showing up every day, answering tough questions, publishing measurable results, and ensuring District 24 receives its fair share of state resources.

_**On June 23rd, the future of our County is on the ballot.

I’m ready to serve — and I’m asking for your vote.**_

In Service,

Kevin Ford for State Senate

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. body:
Happy Friday.
Now is the moment to stand behind strong, serious leadership!
Getting to know a candidate like Rick now isn’t just about one campaign — it’s about shifting the direction of representation and restoring balance in Washington. Momentum is built early, and those who step up now help create the energy, resources, and coalition needed to win the General Election and truly change the power dynamic in DC.
Joining us at this event will let you see firsthand why this campaign is positioned to win — the message, the strategy, and the people behind it. Please come, bring your friends, and be part of building the movement that delivers real results.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/march03withrick "https://secure.actblue.com/donate/march03withrick")
Please join us for a special and important evening at the home of **Amy & Patrick Armstrong**, nestled at the foot of Camelback Mountain, to meet **Rick McCartney** , candidate for Congress in **Arizona’s 1st Congressional District**.
_From our hosts_ :
"We are inviting people from both sides of the aisle to learn more and ask questions. We believe in curiosity, civil discourse, and finding common ground. Our focus for this event is Rick's history supporting businesses of all sizes, his willingness to challenge both Republicans AND Democrats, and his amazing commitment to our community and how we all thrive together. He is not a career politician but someone that has been working within our community for decades and because of this, we truly believe that Rick knows what our district needs and wants."
Please enjoy food and drinks while engaging in meaningful conversation about the future of our district, our state, and our country.
Full event details can be found in the attached invitation. We hope you’ll join us for this informative and impactful evening.

Warm regards,
Rick & Team McCartney

We are just one day away from my end-of-month fundraising deadline.
I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024. Several ultra-MAGA opponents have entered the race. And GOP-aligned Super PACs are already spending millions attacking me.
This is the fight ahead. And I need you by my side.
Before you turn in: [**Can you split a $5 donation between my campaign and Congresswoman Sarah McBride before tomorrow at midnight to help me win in Georgia?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1223?c0=mcb-em-20260227-1.DGRvEZ&refcode=em20260227-2878&t=2&akid=2878%2E21716%2EhKgXwF)

Then we won. Not just a Senate seat, but the Senate majority for Democrats.

In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn't be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.

Now we must win again. And we will win again, in Georgia and in Senate races nationwide.

Just like last time, I can't do it alone.

"Jack Schlossberg is giving people something to believe in again and something to vote for. His candidacy will help democrats win nationwide — and it will help us flip the House."

"Jack understands that progress is not some abstract idea— it must be felt in daily life, in neighborhoods, and in hopes for the future. "Jack possesses a unique ability to navigate the digital and the classical political worlds in ways that can get things done for people — and hold President Trump accoun table. Those skills are critical right now, and they are also quite rare."

name: MassDems featuring Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell
subject: Closing out Black History Month with joy and purpose
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Friend,
As we close out Black History Month, I've been reflecting on what this month means to me—especially as we mourn the loss of Rev. Jesse Jackson, a giant who dedicated his life to the oppressed, the voiceless, and the overlooked. Rev. Jackson taught generations to say, and to believe, "I am somebody." Those words meant everything to people who'd been told otherwise. They still do.
I think about those words when I remember my own story. I have the honor of serving not just as Massachusetts’ first Black woman Attorney General, but as someone whose entire life has been shaped by the struggle, resilience, and faith of Black people who came before me.
I remember my Aunt Lois, who helped raise me after I lost both my parents. She planted seeds of faith and service in me that shaped my sense of purpose—that I'm here to serve something bigger than myself. I remember Mrs. Wilson, my sixth-grade math teacher, who didn't just teach me equations—she brought me extra clothes, encouraged me to join double dutch, and showed me I was worth investing in. I remember meeting Maya Angelou when I was twelve years old, and she told me I would carry her spirit forward. And I remember growing up in my childhood home in Boston, right next to a stop on the Underground Railroad—a reminder that resistance and resilience are in our DNA.
Black History Month is about honoring that legacy. But it's also about the work we're doing right now: continuing the fight for justice, equality, and opportunity that Rev. Jackson and so many others sacrificed for.
As Attorney General, I see my role as part of that continuum. When I sue corporations for exploiting working families, I'm standing on the shoulders of labor leaders who fought for workers' rights. When I defend voting rights and challenge attempts to rewrite the Constitution, I'm honoring the freedom fighters who marched and bled for the right to vote. When I hold law enforcement accountable for racial bias, I'm carrying forward the work of those who demanded justice in a system that wasn't built for people like me.
We all have a role to play in building the future our ancestors fought for. So as we close out Black History Month, I'm asking you to join me in this fight:
* Get engaged and get involved — whether it’s volunteering, organizing in your community, or just showing up when it matters. We need all hands on deck right now.
* Chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can to help us keep fighting for justice and opportunity for all Massachusetts families. Every contribution helps us take on corporations, defend civil rights, and protect the progress we’ve made together.
* Keep pushing. Keep demanding better. Keep believing that we can build a Massachusetts where everyone has a fair shot — because that’s what those who came before us would want.
I'm grateful for this legacy. I'm grateful for Rev. Jackson and every giant who showed us the way. I'm grateful for everyone fighting alongside me. And through it all, I choose joy—not because the fight is easy, but because joy is resistance. It's proof we're still here, still rising, still building a Commonwealth that's more just, more equal, and more free than the one we're living in now.
Rest in power, Reverend. We'll keep saying it: I am somebody.
In solidarity,
