clean_body: [] Friend, As we close out Black History Month, I've been reflecting on what this month means to me—especially as we mourn the loss of Rev. Jesse Jackson, a giant who dedicated his life to the oppressed, the voiceless, and the overlooked. Rev. Jackson taught generations to say, and to believe, "I am somebody." Those words meant everything to people who'd been told otherwise. They still do. I think about those words when I remember my own story. I have the honor of serving not just as Massachusetts’ first Black woman Attorney General, but as someone whose entire life has been shaped by the struggle, resilience, and faith of Black people who came before me. I remember my Aunt Lois, who helped raise me after I lost both my parents. She planted seeds of faith and service in me that shaped my sense of purpose—that I'm here to serve something bigger than myself. I remember Mrs. Wilson, my sixth-grade math teacher, who didn't just teach me equations—she brought me extra clothes, encouraged me to join double dutch, and showed me I was worth investing in. I remember meeting Maya Angelou when I was twelve years old, and she told me I would carry her spirit forward. And I remember growing up in my childhood home in Boston, right next to a stop on the Underground Railroad—a reminder that resistance and resilience are in our DNA. Black History Month is about honoring that legacy. But it's also about the work we're doing right now: continuing the fight for justice, equality, and opportunity that Rev. Jackson and so many others sacrificed for. As Attorney General, I see my role as part of that continuum. When I sue corporations for exploiting working families, I'm standing on the shoulders of labor leaders who fought for workers' rights. When I defend voting rights and challenge attempts to rewrite the Constitution, I'm honoring the freedom fighters who marched and bled for the right to vote. When I hold law enforcement accountable for racial bias, I'm carrying forward the work of those who demanded justice in a system that wasn't built for people like me. We all have a role to play in building the future our ancestors fought for. So as we close out Black History Month, I'm asking you to join me in this fight: Get engaged and get involved — whether it’s volunteering, organizing in your community, or just showing up when it matters. We need all hands on deck right now. Chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can to help us keep fighting for justice and opportunity for all Massachusetts families. Every contribution helps us take on corporations, defend civil rights, and protect the progress we’ve made together. * Keep pushing. Keep demanding better. Keep believing that we can build a Massachusetts where everyone has a fair shot — because that’s what those who came before us would want. I'm grateful for this legacy. I'm grateful for Rev. Jackson and every giant who showed us the way. I'm grateful for everyone fighting alongside me. And through it all, I choose joy—not because the fight is easy, but because joy is resistance. It's proof we're still here, still rising, still building a Commonwealth that's more just, more equal, and more free than the one we're living in now. Rest in power, Reverend. We'll keep saying it: I am somebody. In solidarity, Andrea Joy Campbell [] Attorney General [] [] [] [] Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee Massachusetts Democratic Party 11 Beacon St Suite 410 Boston, MA 02108 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

| [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5833?t=3&akid=9580%2E5257348%2EoZoHC7) **[Derek, I’ll be blunt! I’m about to ask you to split $10 with my leadership PAC, PAC to the Future, and Adam Schiff. subject: Healthcare should not be treated as a bargaining chip
body:
[1]LeftNet

Folks,

I’m a doctor, and if I’m elected, I’d be the first public health official
to ever serve in the United States Senate.

That shouldn’t be remarkable. But in a MAGA-majority Congress, it is.

Right now, healthcare isn’t being treated like a human right. It’s being
treated like a bargaining chip.

MAGA politicians are cutting healthcare funding to funnel even more money
to ICE, so they can continue attacking innocent people and terrorizing our
communities.

We’re watching politicians with no medical background, no public health
training, and no respect for science — from RFK Jr. on down — make
decisions that hurt real people.

It doesn’t take a medical degree to tell you this is insane.

Access to healthcare shouldn’t be up for debate. That’s why I support
Medicare for All, and why I’ve spent my career working to ease the burden
our current broken system puts on working people.

I’m ready to take this fight to the next level, but to do that, I need
your support.

I’ve never taken a dime from Big Pharma. I’m the only candidate in this
race who has never accepted money from corporate PACs — and never will.

That means if we’re going to win and make real, historic progress for
working people, it will be because of grassroots contributors.

In solidarity,

Abdul

A federal judge on Thursday **[rejected a preservation group's bid to halt President Trump's $400 million White House ballroom project,](https://substack.com/redirect/a87a077e-49d7-4149-9410-e6a3d0ddd75f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ruling the challenge unlikely to succeed and allowing privately funded construction--replacing the East Wing--to advance amid ongoing legal battles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a87a077e-49d7-4149-9410-e6a3d0ddd75f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Judge Denies Injunction** : U.S. District Judge Richard Leon dismissed the National Trust for Historic Preservation's request for a preliminary injunction on February 26, citing weak legal theories under the Administrative Procedure Act.
* **Private Funding Confirmed** : The 90,000-square-foot ballroom will be fully financed by private donors including Trump himself with zero taxpayer dollars involved.
* **Preservation Group Plans Appeal** : The National Trust expressed disappointment but noted standing was affirmed and intends to amend its complaint quickly to challenge presidential authority more directly.
* **Approvals Accelerate Project** : The U.S. Commission of Fine Arts recently greenlit designs with further review set for March 5 by the National Capital Planning Commission pushing the expansion forward.

# **[The Retirement Math Nobody Talks About](https://substack.com/redirect/d6729f6f-d0e9-4c8d-ac67-08c763b8774a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Here's a number that should bother you: only 4-5% of retirement accounts ever reach $1 million. Yet financial advisors keep telling people they need _two or three times that_ to retire comfortably. That math doesn't work. And deep down, most investors know it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6729f6f-d0e9-4c8d-ac67-08c763b8774a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So what if the problem isn't how much you've saved -- but _how your account is designed to work for you_?
For 20+ years, I've been teaching everyday investors a different approach. Not "buy and hope." Not chasing the next hot stock. A structured framework built around one idea:
**Income. Every week. Regardless of what the market does.**
It takes about 30 minutes on a Friday. Works with smaller accounts. And once you learn it -- it's a skill you carry for life.
Inside this free guidebook, you'll discover:
* Why waiting for "someday" growth is the riskiest retirement strategy of all
* How weekly options can generate income in up markets, down markets, and sideways markets
* The simple 3-step structure thousands of everyday investors use to pursue $1,000-$5,000 per month
* Why you don't need to predict anything -- just follow the rules

**The market doesn 't owe you a retirement.**
But the right structure might just build you one.

# [OpenAI lands massive $110 Billion funding haul](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa06369-4197-4c44-99af-01128eadd332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI **[secured a record-breaking $110 billion funding round on Friday,](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa06369-4197-4c44-99af-01128eadd332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** led by Amazon's $50 billion commitment, alongside $30 billion each from Nvidia and SoftBank, catapulting its pre-money valuation to $730 billion amid explosive AI demand and a new strategic partnership with Amazon to accelerate enterprise innovation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa06369-4197-4c44-99af-01128eadd332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record Valuation Surge:** OpenAI's pre-money valuation hits $730 billion, more than doubling from recent secondary financing levels and eclipsing rivals like Anthropic.
* **Amazon 's Phased Investment:** Amazon commits $50 billion total, starting with $15 billion immediately and adding $35 billion later upon meeting conditions, plus a multiyear strategic tie-up.
* **Infrastructure Power Boost:** Deal expands OpenAI's AWS partnership by $100 billion over eight years, adds Nvidia compute capacity, and targets $600 billion in total compute spending by 2030.
* **Revenue Growth Projections:** Company forecasts over $280 billion in revenue by 2030, split nearly evenly between consumer and enterprise segments, fueled by surging global AI adoption.

# [Paramount outbids Netflix to grabs Warner Bros empire](https://substack.com/redirect/54a40caa-7665-418f-9271-6fd929befdf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Netflix walked away from its deal to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery's studio and streaming assets Thursday after the company's board deemed Paramount Skydance's revised **[$31-per-share all-cash offer for the entire company superior,](https://substack.com/redirect/54a40caa-7665-418f-9271-6fd929befdf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/54a40caa-7665-418f-9271-6fd929befdf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)clearing the path for a blockbuster merger that promises greater shareholder value but faces regulatory hurdles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/54a40caa-7665-418f-9271-6fd929befdf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Superior Offer Secured** : Paramount Skydance's $31-per-share all-cash bid for all of Warner Bros. Discovery outpaced Netflix's $27.75-per-share proposal for select assets, prompting the WBD board to declare it superior.
* **Breakup Fees Covered** : Paramount agreed to pay a $7 billion regulatory termination fee if the deal fails antitrust review and cover the $2.8 billion fee WBD owed Netflix for terminating their agreement.
* **Netflix Declines Match** : Netflix co-CEOs stated the higher price made the transaction no longer financially attractive, emphasizing discipline over pursuing a "must-have" deal at any cost.
* **Market Reactions Mixed** : Netflix shares surged 10% on the news, reflecting relief from the overhang, while Warner Bros. Discovery stock dipped 2% amid the shift to the full-company acquisition.

# [Fmr Twitter CEO shocks tech world, fires nearly half his startup workforce ](https://substack.com/redirect/564513e0-fd12-4614-95e7-81e01b84348d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Block, the fintech giant led by Jack Dorsey, announced Thursday it is **[laying off more than 4,000 employees](https://substack.com/redirect/564513e0-fd12-4614-95e7-81e01b84348d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --nearly half its workforce of over 10,000--to embrace AI-driven efficiency and accelerate growth, sending shares surging as much as 24% in extended trading.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/564513e0-fd12-4614-95e7-81e01b84348d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive AI pivot** : The cuts reduce Block's headcount from over 10,000 to under 6,000, enabling smaller teams to leverage AI for faster innovation and automation.
* **Dorsey 's bold stance** : CEO Jack Dorsey argued proactive deep cuts avoid repeated layoffs' damage to morale and trust, predicting most companies will follow suit within a year.
* **Strong financial backdrop** : Announced alongside Q4 results showing adjusted EPS of 65 cents and 24% gross profit growth, with upbeat full-year guidance beating estimates.
* **Restructuring costs ahead** : The company expects $450-500 million in charges mostly in Q1 for severance and benefits, with changes largely complete by mid-2026.

# [Florida man busted in massive $328M Crypto Ponzi scam](https://substack.com/redirect/96c9af88-e6bf-4506-abd9-82f9b27f37a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A 34-year-old Florida man was arrested Wednesday on federal wire fraud and money laundering charges for allegedly running a **[$328 million cryptocurrency Ponzi scheme](https://substack.com/redirect/96c9af88-e6bf-4506-abd9-82f9b27f37a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** through his company Goliath Ventures, promising investors monthly returns from fake liquidity pools while using new funds to pay earlier ones and finance luxury purchases.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/96c9af88-e6bf-4506-abd9-82f9b27f37a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Scheme Operated Three Years** : From January 2023 to January 2026, Delgado solicited nationwide investments by touting crypto liquidity pool returns, backed by referrals, marketing, events, and partial payouts to build trust.
* **Funds Misused Lavishly** : Investor money funded earlier returns, refunds, extravagant parties, holiday events, luxury travel, and no real crypto investments occurred.
* **Luxury Properties Bought** : Delgado allegedly purchased four high-end residential properties with victim funds, valued from $1.15 million to $8.5 million each.
* **Severe Penalties Loom** : If convicted on all charges, the Apopka resident faces up to 30 years in federal prison, with investigations led by IRS and Homeland Security.

* * *
# [Saudi Aramco unleashes shale gas revolution in desert](https://substack.com/redirect/b2511498-0291-4d67-b29a-aac1f4ffcdc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Saudi Aramco has kicked off production at its massive Jafurah shale gas field in the Arabian Desert, a $100 billion megaproject that began outputting in December 2025 and aims to **[transform the kingdom into a major global gas player](https://substack.com/redirect/b2511498-0291-4d67-b29a-aac1f4ffcdc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while freeing up crude for export.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b2511498-0291-4d67-b29a-aac1f4ffcdc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive reserves unlocked** : Jafurah holds 229 trillion cubic feet of raw gas and 75 billion barrels of condensate, positioning it as potentially the largest shale gas development outside the United States.
* **Ambitious production targets** : By 2030, the field is set to deliver 2 billion cubic feet of sales gas per day, 420 million cubic feet of ethane, and 630,000 barrels of high-value liquids daily.
* **Strategic partnerships deployed** : Aramco collaborates with U.S. firm Halliburton and China's Sinopec, using advanced "walking rigs" to accelerate drilling in a high-tech approach mirroring the American shale boom.
* **Economic diversification boost** : The project supports Vision 2030 by replacing 500,000 barrels per day of crude in domestic power generation, potentially adding $12.8 billion in annual revenue at $70 oil prices.

# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Polls are now showing _only 3 points_ between me and Greg Abbott.

_We’re proving we are a real threat — and we’re inches away from making history._
**[Our primary is in just a few days on March 3, and we need to show we’re ready to win. Will you contribute $5 today to help turn 3 points into a victory?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260227_1_ann.a8Q7Bg&refcode=em20260227-663&amount=5&t=1&akid=663%2E299639%2EJjcdxi)**

Our fundraising goals are not just arbitrary numbers. We need to reach them to fund digital ads for Texas screens across the state. We need them to power thousands of text messages to mobilize our supporters, and for all of the final door-knocking and conversations in neighborhoods Abbott has ignored for years.
**[We’re in winning territory. But it’s going to take people coming together in a big way to push us over the edge. Can you pitch in $5 to join this movement?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260227_1_ann.a8Q7Bg&refcode=em20260227-663&amount=5&t=2&akid=663%2E299639%2EJjcdxi)**

Gina Hinojosa

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Make Monopolies Scared Again
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Once we take power, we’re going to break up those companies. So all the bribes, all the investment they made to create these mergers, it’s all going to be for naught.
#

Peter,
Over the past year we’ve watched as the wealthiest people and the biggest companies in the world bent over backwards to placate Trump in return for favorable treatment.
That’s corruption. It’s crony capitalism. Monopolies are bad. Monopolies beholden to the most corrupt president in history are much, much worse.
Once we take power, we’re going to break up those companies. So all the bribes, all the investment they made to create these mergers, it’s all going to be for naught. Their investors are going to be pissed at them, and they’re going to end up getting fired because they wasted so much money and corrupted themselves in the process.
I am not bluffing. There will be consequences. We have to make it so painful that generations from now CEOs will flinch at the idea of business corruptly teaming up with government.
But we can’t do any of that if we don’t have power. We need to win majorities in Congress in 2026, and the presidency in 2028.
I’m going to be everywhere I possibly can over the next year trying to defeat Trump candidates and put Democrats in Congress who will hold him and his rich friends accountable.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: I am not going to break...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I am going to fight this with everything I have. But don’t make the mistake of thinking this is just about me. It’s about every person who has the courage to speak out against Trump.
Team: I’m writing to ask you for $5.
That’s right: just $5.
$5 because I’ve had enough of Trump and Hegseth’s attacks on our Constitution.
$5 because Donald Trump wants to stamp out any and all opposition, and he’s willing to undermine your First Amendment rights to do it.
$5 because he’s sent Pete Hegseth after me, and he’s moving ahead with a sham investigation to drag my name through the mud and destroy what I fought for during my 25 years in uniform.
I am not going to break. I am going to fight this with everything I have. But don’t make the mistake of thinking this is just about me. It’s about every person who has the courage to speak out against Trump.
Trump wants us living in fear. I don’t intend to let him win. I need your help.

name: Mai Vang
subject: They just proved our point.
body:
People described Democrats as “spineless,” “paralyzed,” and “afraid.”

| | | | | | [|
---](https://maiforus.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe5f60ccb8fb671f0c1857dc9&id=4779c4792b&e=dd5af5b7b1)
| | | | | |
Friends,

Earlier this month, a _New York Times_ focus group of Democratic voters went viral. People described the party as **“spineless,” “paralyzed,”** and **“afraid.”**

Polling shows most Democratic voters want new leadership.

**Then last weekend at the California Democratic Party convention, party leadership cheated to ensure a 21-year incumbent received the party’s endorsement in our race.**

You can see why people feel disconnected.

When voters are asking for new leadership to fight Trump and the billionaires, and party insiders step in to protect the status quo, the frustration keeps growing.

Our party is strongest when it listens to working families -- not when it bends rules to shield incumbents.

What happened last weekend doesn’t discourage me. It makes me more determined to take this campaign directly to the people of CA-07 -- knocking doors, organizing, and earning every vote the right way.

I don’t take any money from corporate PACs. Our campaign is fully funded by the grassroots. If you believe CA-07 deserves a real choice, this is the moment to show it.

[**There are fewer than 100 days until the primary, and before this week comes to an end we’re asking supporters to help us continue building momentum. Can you chip in $5, $35, or whatever you can today?**](https://maiforus.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe5f60ccb8fb671f0c1857dc9&id=e1dde8de6d&e=dd5af5b7b1)

This is our moment to build something better.

In solidarity,

Mai

FIRST: David and his team at Towards Justice filed a case back in 2014 against ICE’s private prison contractor, GEO Group, in what may be the largest human trafficking class action in United States history.
THEN: In a separate case, a Denver judge ruled that the Colorado Department of Corrections and Governor Jared Polis violated our state’s constitutional ban on involuntary servitude by forcing incarcerated people to work. This first-in-the-nation case, also led by David and his team at Toward Justice, is a major win for the fight to end slavery and involuntary solitude in our state.
NOW: After a decade-long fight led by David and his team, the Supreme Court unanimously shut down GEO Group’s attempt to dodge accountability for forcing tens of thousands of detained immigrants in Aurora to work.
The message is crystal clear: no corporation gets a free pass to violate people’s rights. “Just following orders” doesn’t put you above the law.
While David has been campaigning across Colorado, he’s also been using the law boldly to take on corporations and powerful interests. The best part? He’s winning .
We’re at our end-of-month deadline , and moments like this matter. Especially because corporate interests are watching this race closely.

name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- February 27, 2026
body:
|

---
Dear Friends and Neighbors,
This Administration's illegal and disastrous tariffs have hurt Marylanders - the families who have struggled every day to put food on the table, the farmers on the Eastern Shore, the small businesses in downtown Baltimore, the manufacturers in Mountain Maryland - and everyone in between. Finally, the Supreme Court ruled many of these tariffs illegal; affirming that the President lacks authority to use the International Emergency Economic Powers Act to impose tariffs. The Court reaffirmed that the power of the purse resides with Congress.
When I first came to the Senate one year ago, I knew I needed to act fast to hold the President and Republicans accountable for these disastrous tariffs. My first bill, the Tariff Transparency Act, would have required the Trump Administration to disclose the true cost of many of these tariffs to the American people. Republicans blocked it. I continued to fight for Maryland businesses, farmers, and families in fighting against these tariffs - joining many amicus briefs at every step of the litigation process, including the Supreme Court case that led to the decision handed down last week.
This decision reaffirms Congress' responsibility to set trade policy. The Administration must work with Congress quickly to refund Marylanders for the money they have paid for tariffs that were chaotic, arbitrary, and now illegal.

The efforts to cover up the true effects of the Trump tariffs are far reaching within his Administration, and this week, I, along with Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.), Senate Banking Committee Ranking Member Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.), and Senate Finance Committee Ranking Member Ron Wyden (D-Ore.) led colleagues in demanding answers from White House National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett following his suggestion that Federal Reserve staff be "disciplined" over an independent report concluding that tariffs are harming American businesses and consumers.
We demanded that Director Hassett formally retract his suggestion that civil servants be punished for producing data demonstrating the true cost of the Trump tariffs. My colleagues and I requested answers regarding the protection of career civil servants, the independence of the Federal Reserve, and whether the White House has interfered with or pressured agencies responsible for publishing other economic data - like the Bureau of Labor Statistics' monthly jobs report.
On February 18, 2026, Hassett made the troubling suggestion that Federal Reserve officials be disciplined for an evidence-based study which concluded that American consumers and businesses are bearing the economic burden of President Trump's chaotic tariffs. Hassett's comments undermine the Federal Reserve's independent research, call into question the integrity of its future data, and suggest the Trump Administration is more interested in prohibiting Americans from learning the cost of its tariff regime than meaningfully lowering costs for American families.
We will continue to demand answers and accountability on behalf of the American people because it's clear that this Administration is hellbent on taking over the Federal Reserve and appears willing to do it by any means even though it generates uncertainty in the markets; distracts the Federal Reserve from its statutory mandate; and does nothing to address the affordability crisis. Read the full letter [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15520.16623103.5969514.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fwp-content%2fuploads%2f2026%2f02%2fFinal-Letter-2.23.26.pdf&redir_log=826790907452549). **Fighting for Your Health **
To be frank, I am voting **NO** on Nominee for Surgeon General. Dr. Casey Means. She appeared for a confirmation hearing before the Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) Committee on Wednesday, and I asked about dangerous products she advertised - and received compensation for - in her newsletter. Even just a basic search of the products she's peddled to her followers finds they contain lead, cadmium, and other carcinogens and reproductive toxins.
Her hypocrisy is real. Her hypocrisy is dangerous. She is railing against pharmaceutical companies and the safety of the FDA-approved vaccines that they produce, all while making money hawking products that have not gone through the same rigorous, evidence-based approval process that vaccines go through - even some that contain unsafe levels of heavy metals. While Means' entire brand is based on being a wellness-influencer, promoting "safe" products that are not promoted by the pharmaceutical or agricultural industries, she is cashing checks from supplement companies with dubious health benefits after promoting them in her newsletters. Dr. Means makes recommendations for products while failing to disclose that she benefits from the sale of these products or that she is promoting companies for which she is an investor or adviser. The Surgeon General holds a position of public trust as America's top doctor. Meanwhile, Means' integrity has been compromised by countless conflicts of interest - from supplement companies, health tech companies, to Big Tobacco.
**Fighting Through Legislation **
It's been a busy couple of weeks in Washington, and I wanted to take a moment to share some of the legislation I have introduced and cosponsored:

Women's Heart Health Expansion Act: This bipartisan bill reauthorizes and strengthens the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) WISEWOMAN program to expand access to cardiovascular disease screening and preventive health services for underserved women. The bill authorizes supplemental grants to support blood pressure and cholesterol screening, risk reduction education, and referral and follow-up services, and expands eligibility to include additional low-income women beyond those already served through the National Breast and Cervical Cancer Early Detection Program. It also broadens the types of approved providers that may deliver services and authorizes 250 million dollars in funding for fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

Legislation I have cosponsored:

Chesapeake Bay Watershed Advancement for Training, Education, Restoration, and Science (WATERS) Act: This bill would reauthorize the National Oceanic Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Chesapeake Bay Office (CBO), which supports the restoration of the Bay and connects local businesses, nonprofits, schools, and residents to coastal resilience and restoration efforts.

Julius Rosenwald and Rosenwald Schools National Historical Park Act: This bill would create the Julius Rosenwald and Rosenwald Schools National Historical Park.

Need for Speed Act: This bill would require the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) to develop and maintain a National Infrastructure Intelligence Tool.

Tariff Refund Act: This bill would require the U.S. Customs and Border Protection to pay refunds of all tariffs that were unlawfully imposed by the President.

The Responsible Firearms Marketing Act: This bill would direct the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to study and report on the gun industry's use of unfair and deceptive marketing practices, with specific focus on practices that target minors, encourage illegal use of firearms, or relate to the sales of semiautomatic assault weapons, and to promulgate regulations to prohibit unfair and deceptive advertising by the gun industry. The bill would also give the FTC authority to apply existing rules regarding unfair marketing practices to firearm distributors, including punitive fines and payment of damages to consumers.

TRUST Act of 2026: This bipartisan bill would amend the Federal Deposit Insurance Act to permit Federal banking agencies to examine qualifying insured depository institutions with under $6,000,000,000 in total assets not less than once during each 18-month period.

Service-Disabled Veteran Opportunities in Small Business Act: This bipartisan bill would require the SBA to issue guidance for the extension of contracts to small businesses owned by service-disabled veterans more effectively. The bipartisan legislation would also require the SBA to issue a report to Congress detailing a list of each Federal agency that failed to meet its contracting goals and provide training for Federal agencies that fail to meet contracting goals.

A resolution celebrating Black History Month (Agreed to in the Senate!)

**In the Community**
I was honored to be recognized at the 41st Carver Washington Scholarship Brunch. The legacies of George Washington Carver and Booker T. Washington, rooted in leadership and service, continue to inspire. I am grateful to the Baltimore Tuskegee Alumni Club for continuing to invest in the next generation.
I had an invigorating conversation with Cecil County businesses and county leadership hosted by the Cecil County Office of Economic Development. I heard about their successes, challenges, and opportunities. I will continue to fight for economic opportunity for all Marylanders.

It was amazing to tour the new Great Wolf Lodge in Cecil County! One million individuals visit and enjoy the amenities each year, bringing families, tourists and an economic boom to the county and region.

I met with leaders from the Army Alliance, Aberdeen Proving Ground, and local partners in Aberdeen to learn about their vision for the future. Maryland plays a critical role in our national security, and I'm committed to advancing investments that strengthen our communities.
I toured SURVICE Engineering in Belcamp, where they are helping advance cutting-edge drone technology. I was proud to secure federal funding that strengthens our national security and keeps Maryland at the forefront of research, development, and innovation.
Great to have lunch at Box Hill Pizzeria & Crab Cakes in Abingdon! Owned by the Kanaras family since 1984, it's so popular that they sold 20,000 crabcakes in the month of December!
The YWCA of Annapolis & Anne Arundel is on the front lines supporting survivors of domestic violence. I joined Senator Chris Van Hollen and Rep. Sarah Elfreth to deliver $697,000 in federal funding to strengthen and expand their lifesaving work in Anne Arundel County.

I hosted "Real Men, Real Talk" with County Executive Calvin Ball and an incredible panel of experts to discuss the physical, mental & emotional health of men and boys. Too many suffer in silence and we must break the stigma.

I visited the YMCA in Abingdon to meet with Y Maryland leadership about the critical services they provide, from youth programs to senior support. As funding challenges grow, I'll keep fighting to protect SNAP, Medicaid, and Head Start so families can access the care they deserve.

Honored to celebrate the grand opening of the High Ridge Center, County Executive Ball's visionary project and one of the first spaces of its kind to bring all Divine 9 organizations under one roof. More than a building, it's a hub for service, fellowship and community.

I met with towing and roadside professionals who keep our roads safe. As we work on transportation reauthorization, I'm focused on safety and accountability.

**Know Before You Go**
Summer travel is fast approaching and if you are planning to travel internationally, make sure you enroll in the State Department's Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP). This is a free service to allow U.S. citizens and nationals to enroll their trip abroad so the Department of State can accurately and quickly contact them in case of emergency. By enrolling in STEP, you will get updates about health, weather, safety, and security for your destination, allows you to plan your trip using information from the local U.S. embassy and helps the embassy or consulate contact you if there's an emergency like a natural disaster, civil unrest, or a family emergency.

Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15520.16623103.5969514.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fmytravel.state.gov%2fs%2fstep%3fgad_source%3d1%26gad_campaignid%3d21758807661%26gbraid%3d0AAAAAqbBk5tE7eqSiBcXCv4TYEQOwrMDQ%26gclid%3dEAIaIQobChMIss3a18z3kgMV7h9ECB0SmTh-EAAYASAAEgIy9PD_BwE&redir_log=034687519171218) to enter enroll in STEP.

**Get Back on Your Feet **
We are excited to host a "[Get Back on Your Feet](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15520.16623103.5969514.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdocs.google.com%2fforms%2fd%2fe%2f1FAIpQLSdmXtSIr2pGAxhCCA5RZ2J8BXBJb85ig3p0tbGzu6AQxmllhA%2fviewform&redir_log=89522618923660)" event hosted in collaboration with United Way of the National Capital Area! This event, which will be held Saturday, March 28, is designed to support Marylanders as they continue to grapple with rising costs and a difficult economy.
Utility providers from across the region will be available to help consumers access information and assistance with their bills. Credit counselors, debt repair specialists, legal aid representatives, rental assistance and financial advisors will also be on site to offer guidance and resources. The credit improvement and repair resource table will provide Marylanders with practical guidance on rebuilding credit, understanding credit reports, and accessing tools to improve financial stability, helping them regain confidence and control over their financial future. Additionally, the College of Southern Maryland will incorporate their Center for Workforce Development, which offers a range of workforce programs that provide quick credentialing and employment readiness.
[](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15520.16623103.5969514.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdocs.google.com%2fforms%2fd%2fe%2f1FAIpQLSdmXtSIr2pGAxhCCA5RZ2J8BXBJb85ig3p0tbGzu6AQxmllhA%2fviewform&redir_log=89522618923660)

**Honoring Reverend Jesse Jackson**
As you may know, last week our nation and the world lost a giant. So many of us have the indelible black-and-white still images of Rev. Jackson fighting for justice in the Civil Rights Movement committed to memory. But keeping him there doesn't do him justice. Rev. Jackson moved in living color, leaving his mark over decades of world history.
He marched with Dr. King in tireless pursuit of voting rights and civil rights for Black Americans. He ran for president and forever changed the face of electoral politics, giving a voice to the overlooked and unheard. He flew around the globe as a humanitarian, chasing injustice across oceans and borders.
He fought for the poverty stricken in rural America, and the poor living in our cities. He worked on behalf of farmers and labor unions. He protested for student rights and advocated for humane treatment of immigrants. Whether you were imprisoned by injustice or indignity, he was there to remind you, 'I am somebody.' And time and time again, Rev. Jackson stood at the front, putting his own life at risk in an effort to liberate millions more. He lived his faith, driven by a moral conviction that civil rights, human rights, and economic justice together created a big tent that had room for everyone.
Rev. Jackson prepared generations to carry the torch forward. And at a time when our nation's conscience doesn't always speak as loudly as it should, and many of the fights that Rev. Jackson fought are still ongoing, his example shows us that the way to keep hope alive for enduring justice is through the work we're willing to do for it.
My prayers continue to be with my House colleague Rep. Jonathan Jackson and the entire Jackson family.
**Stay in the Fight ** I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office or connect with us at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15520.16623103.5969514.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov%2f&redir_log=346519414955204). You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks
United States Senator
[Click here to Unsubscribe.](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/EForm.aspx?__cid=SenAlsobrooks&__fid=100022&__crop=15520.16623103.5969514.7190525)

Utility providers from across the region will be available to help consumers access information and assistance with their bills. Credit counselors, debt repair specialists, legal aid representatives, rental assistance and financial advisors will also be on site to offer guidance and resources. The credit improvement and repair resource table will provide Marylanders with practical guidance on rebuilding credit, understanding credit reports, and accessing tools to improve financial stability, helping them regain confidence and control over their financial future. Additionally, the College of Southern Maryland will incorporate their Center for Workforce Development, which offers a range of workforce programs that provide quick credentialing and employment readiness. Honoring Reverend Jesse Jackson As you may know, last week our nation and the world lost a giant. So many of us have the indelible black-and-white still images of Rev. Jackson fighting for justice in the Civil Rights Movement committed to memory. But keeping him there doesn't do him justice. Rev. Jackson moved in living color, leaving his mark over decades of world history. He marched with Dr. King in tireless pursuit of voting rights and civil rights for Black Americans. He ran for president and forever changed the face of electoral politics, giving a voice to the overlooked and unheard. He flew around the globe as a humanitarian, chasing injustice across oceans and borders. He fought for the poverty stricken in rural America, and the poor living in our cities. He worked on behalf of farmers and labor unions. He protested for student rights and advocated for humane treatment of immigrants. Whether you were imprisoned by injustice or indignity, he was there to remind you, 'I am somebody.' And time and time again, Rev. Jackson stood at the front, putting his own life at risk in an effort to liberate millions more. He lived his faith, driven by a moral conviction that civil rights, human rights, and economic justice together created a big tent that had room for everyone. Rev. Jackson prepared generations to carry the torch forward. And at a time when our nation's conscience doesn't always speak as loudly as it should, and many of the fights that Rev. Jackson fought are still ongoing, his example shows us that the way to keep hope alive for enduring justice is through the work we're willing to do for it. My prayers continue to be with my House colleague Rep. Jonathan Jackson and the entire Jackson family. Stay in the Fight I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office or connect with us at . You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks United States Senator

We know the drill with Trump at this point, Team. Everything he says is a "joke" until it's suddenly real. That's why we have to take him at his word, whether it is his attacks on mail-in ballots, his threat to prosecute political opponents over an old election, or his jokes about canceling the upcoming midterm election.
RUSH $35 or more today to defend mail-in ballots, protect early voting, and make every voice heard in our elections in November and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022726_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Politico: Trump says individuals will soon be prosecuted for 2020 election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022726_2&amount=25]
Donald Trump flew to Davos, Switzerland this week, Team, to meet with and give a speech to our European allies. So, of course, President Trump spent his time talking about the 2020 election as he threatens not to hold elections in 2026 . In his own words:
“ It's a war [Ukraine] that should have never started and it wouldn't have started if the 2020 US presidential election weren't rigged. It was a rigged election. Everybody now knows that. They found out. People will soon be prosecuted for what they did. ”
Again, millions of taxpayer dollars have been spent by MAGA elected officials across multiple states looking for evidence of election fraud in 2020, and nothing has been found. Despite years of effort by opponents of voting rights, no valid proof of any misdeeds relating to the 2020 election has been brought to light, even as wave after wave of suppressive legislation has been made law.
Now, Trump is also threatening prosecutions. Who is he targeting? We don't know, even though his MAGA Department of Justice has sued Fulton County, Georgia (home to Atlanta) for ballots and other election materials from 2020. What we do know is that Trump has already weaponized the federal government against his perceived political opponents, like former FBI Director James Comey and New York Attorney General Letitia James. Is his 2024 opponent, Kamala Harris, next? 2020 campaign staff? Or Joe Biden himself?
What we do know is that this is all wrong, and we have to defend our fundamental right to vote before it's too late . The fate of mail-in ballots, early voting programs, voter outreach initiatives, and voter registration drives depends on our work right now, ahead of November.
Pitch in $35 or whatever you can today to help us protect voting rights, defend the use of vote-by-mail, and increase voter participation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022726_2&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

This isn't the first time during this term that Trump has claimed 2020 was "stolen". He's continued to push the claim that Dominion voting machines had been rigged against him on social media, and he's issued executive orders targeting the use of vote-by-mail. He pushed his MAGA staff at DOJ to sue dozens of largely Democratic-controlled states for access to their voter rolls. Trump has also repeatedly sought to assert federal control over elections, which are run by the states.
This is a big red warning sign for our elections coming up and our fight for voting rights in general. If the sitting president still can't accept defeat years later after winning another election and returning to power, what makes us think he'll accept election losses by his party in November?
We have to do the work, right now, to fight back. We can't wait until this summer, or even the primaries this spring, to start caring about our elections. We have to stand up in this moment to make sure we have elections in November and that the results will be respected, even by opponents of voting rights if they lose.
Help us fight the vote suppressors with $35 or whatever you can and make every vote count this November around the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=022726_2&amount=35]

It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.
It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.

clean_body: | | FROM: FMR. SPEAKER NEWT GINGRICH TO: YOU RE: CENSUS RECOUNT PETITION **** Newt Gingrich here. Let me be very clear with you. ** I've seen it before. And I stopped it before. It started in 1998 when I was Speaker of the House. The Clinton Administration attempted to fundamentally corrupt the U.S. Census. Their plan was called " statistical sampling." In plain English, it would have allowed unelected bureaucrats to manufacture population numbers instead of counting real people, one at a time. Red states would be undercounted. Blue states would be completely inflated. Congressional seats would be rigged before a single vote was cast. It was a direct assault on representative government, Peter. So I sued Bill Clinton --and won. The Supreme Court sided with me in a nail-biting 5-4 ruling. They agreed the only legitimate way to count the Census was by a strict, physical headcount. That victory protected the integrity of our elections for a generation. Now the same election scam is back. The Democrats are demanding tens of millions of Biden 's illegal aliens be counted in the Census. Not because it's lawful. Not because it's constitutional. But because it would permanently tilt political power in the Democrats' favor. Over thirty years in politics, and I can't recall a more brazen attempt to subvert the American system. And it 's happening right now in SOCIALIST SUPERSTATES like California and New York. These Democrats didn't roll out the red carpet for millions of illegals out of "compassion"... Republicans like you and me are now facing the most important midterm election of our lifetimes, and we have a clear choice to make: Are we going to let the Democrats STEAMROLL us through rigged Census counts? Or are we going to put U.S. elections back in the hands of U.S. citizens? Below is a petition calling for a CITIZENS ONLY CENSUS RECOUNT. We must put Congress in a pressure cooker. There's no bigger task than the task to secure our elections. Do NOT let the Democrats cheat their way to power. Do NOT let illegal aliens steal your vote. I know we can win this fight. I 've won it before - but I need you by my side. For America, Newt Gingrich Fmr. Peter,
The war on President Trump started the instant he stepped off that golden escalator in 2015 and promised to put America First.
**The Democrat Machine, their media pawns, and entrenched Deep State bureaucrats declared total war with no rules and no mercy.**
They hit him with the **Russia witch hunt** that dragged on for years, costing hundreds of millions and tearing the country apart.
When that collapsed, they pivoted straight to the **impeachment effort** – a manufactured crisis built on lies, designed to nullify your vote and remove a duly elected President.

Because naturally if you were doing an Epstein investigation, you'd want to get answers from someone who'd never met him, didn't know him, and had never been to his island.

But [Hillary kept her cool](https://default.salsalabs.org/T274ebef1-7eac-4b6c-8d7f-dc1dd79bdd86/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), even in the face of all the GOP jackassery, and answered their questions while concurrently telling them how absurd they and hypocritical they were, and how if they really gave a crap about abuse of children, they'd bring in Trump. And it got weird, really weird, with questions about UFOs and pizza-driven conspiracies, and, well, things you'd expect from the moron caucus that makes up the GOP. But still she held strong, probably thinking, "I can't believe I still need to deal with this s***," but dealing with it nonetheless, and doing a masterful job.

[**So please add your name, and join us in thanking her for showing what jackasses House Republicans are.**

**" Thank you, Hillary!"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T80964d33-fc2c-49ad-9bcb-7ad8d07d5691/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

After Trump pulls endorsement, CD3 Republicans weigh loyalty and constitutional independence
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** SB26-070 would require warrants for [access to vehicle tracking data](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while a statewide prostitution decriminalization plan [raises trafficking concerns](https://link.email.joinrmv.). HB1037 would [block police from purchasing certain consumer data](https://link.email.joinrmv.) without a warrant, despite law enforcement pushback. All of it comes amid a [56% surge in bill volume since 2012](https://link.email.joinrmv.), fueling transparency concerns as government grows.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado accepted [$7.2 million in federal climate funds](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as Xcel reported [$903 million in profit](https://link.email.joinrmv.) while seeking rate hikes. Denver is weighing [energy-code expansions](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to single-family homes and [directing police to intervene in ICE operations](https://link.email.joinrmv.) if force is deemed excessive. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court [declined to shield a private prison firm from suit](https://link.email.joinrmv.), Laura Clellan was confirmed to [lead Parks and Wildlife](https://link.email.joinrmv.), and critics argue rising costs stem from [government overspending](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
In Colorado’s CD3, [Trump’s withdrawal of support for Rep. Jeff Hurd](https://link.email.joinrmv.) has intensified debate over loyalty and constitutional independence within the GOP. Meanwhile, pastor Dathan Jones has [entered Colorado’s U.S. Senate race](https://link.email.joinrmv.), citing affordability, energy policy and border enforcement as reasons he can “no longer sit on the sidelines."
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Newly declassified CIA files detail Cold War [mind-control experiments](https://link.email.joinrmv.) under Project Artichoke. Vermont reversed a policy requiring foster parents to [affirm gender ideology](https://link.email.joinrmv.), marking a First Amendment win. A commentary [credits President Trump’s first year](https://link.email.joinrmv.) with economic gains, border security and lower crime, while Hillary Clinton’s Epstein-related deposition was [briefly halted after a photo leak](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, February 27, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[After Trump pulls endorsement, CD3 Republicans weigh loyalty and constitutional independence](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
President Donald Trump’s decision to revoke his endorsement of Rep. Jeff Hurd and instead back primary challenger Hope Scheppelman reshaped the Republican race in Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District. It also sharpened a debate inside the party: does representation mean standing firm on constitutional ground—even when that conflicts with the president—or aligning closely with the America First agenda?
From Durango to Grand Junction, Republicans are trying to sort out what Trump’s move means—not just for June, but for November.
Delta County resident Shirley Bauer said Trump’s announcement hit her hard. “When I heard President Trump pulled his endorsement of Rep. Jeff Hurd, it honestly threw me for a loop. I felt like I got kicked in the gut.”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[You can’t afford your government: The cost of Colorado’s “affordability” agenda](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY DAVE KERBER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Affordability rhetoric masks spending reality:** The commentary argues Democrats campaigned on “affordability” while ignoring that massive post-COVID and Inflation Reduction Act spending helped fuel inflation in the first place.
* **Redistribution doesn’t reduce costs:** Proposals like extended Obamacare subsidies, rent control and taxpayer-funded programs simply shift money from one group to another without lowering actual prices, while expanding government power.
* **Government spending is the real burden:** From a $200 million EPA heat-pump grant to costly transit subsidies and studies, the author contends Coloradans aren’t failing affordability—the government’s spending habits are.

* **Economic turnaround and tax relief:** The commentary credits President Trump with reversing economic decline, increasing real wages by over $1,100, delivering the largest tax cut in history, and cutting gas prices by more than $2 per gallon in Colorado.
* **Affordability and opportunity gains:** It highlights lower mortgage rates, the creation of “Trump Accounts” seeded with $1,000 for newborns, and expanded rural healthcare funding aimed at strengthening Colorado communities.
* **Border security and crime reduction:** The piece points to what it calls the most secure border in history, large-scale deportations of criminal illegal immigrants, and reported drops in violent crime and fentanyl deaths as evidence of restored law and order.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE.
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: February 27, 2026 Dan Cox Files Public Information Act Requests Seeking Governor Moore’s Communications with Maryland Electric Utilities and PJM Interconnection HELP DAN CAMPAIGN FOR GOVERNOR TO STAND UP FOR MARYLANDERS
[](https://dancoxforgovernor.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=498f2aa8a4&e=5bb5efcda7) Annapolis, Maryland — Dan Cox announced today that he has formally submitted multiple Maryland Public Information Act (MPIA) requests, at his own personal expense, seeking records from Governor Wes Moore’s Office and key state agencies regarding recent communications with Maryland’s four major electric utilities — Baltimore Gas & Electric (BGE), Pepco, Delmarva Power & Light, and Potomac Edison — as well as PJM Interconnection, the regional grid operator responsible for wholesale electricity markets affecting Maryland ratepayers. "It is an outrageous burden on Marylanders to now face sometimes tripled or even quadrupled electric bills without any executive action by the Governor to order immediate substantial relief," Dan stated. "Instead, today Governor Moore is blaming foreign companies having to pay their fair share instead of ripping us off, all while Governor Moore is ripping off the Marylander ratepayer. "As your Governor I won't delay, on day one I will act and order an immediate freeze of all electric rate increases since November 2025, order collections and fees to halt, and order the Governor's Energy Administration, the PSC, and the Office of the People's counsel to investigate and provide an immediate report and relief package for Marylanders including coordinating and taking any necessary legal action for emergency injunctive relief to stop the theft of our electricity ratepayers. "Governor Moore has complete control of a nearly $70 billion budget, and his $350 million dollar funded offices that oversee the skyrocketing electric bills are nearly silent except to blame foreign tariffs for rising costs of living, which is absurd considering the burden Wes Moore has caused with his inaction as electric bills skyrocket. "Marylanders are getting fleeced of their incomes by this out of touch administration while receiving Less with Wes Moore." Cox’s requests seek communications, internal discussions, enforcement actions, investigations, and any potential litigation strategies involving these utilities and PJM from November 1, 2025 to the present. “Marylanders are facing what many are describing as skyrocketing and in some cases quadrupling electric bills,” Cox said. “Taxpayers deserve to know what communications have occurred between Governor Moore’s administration and the utilities or PJM while families struggle to pay basic energy costs.” Cox noted that Governor Moore oversees a $68 billion state budget, including: • Approximately $8.3 million for the Office of People’s Counsel (OPC); • Approximately $30 million for the Public Service Commission (PSC); • Approximately $287 million for the Maryland Energy Administration; • Approximately $23 million for the Office of the Governor; Cox stated that, in his view, these agencies collectively represent roughly $350 million in taxpayer-funded operations that have not produced meaningful relief for Maryland ratepayers. Cox further pointed to reports that approximately $300 million from the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) ratepayer funds in the SEIF fund (Strategic Energy Investment Fund) was redirected by Gov. Moore to help balance the bloated state budget, rather than being used for energy cost mitigation. Cox stated that he is investigating the decision-making behind that allocation and its impact on electric bills. “I am investigating what I believe is unacceptable inaction,” Cox said. “Marylanders deserve transparency and immediate relief. I am calling on Governor Moore to issue executive orders directing his administration to take immediate action to reduce electric costs, and to pursue appropriate legal remedies — including seeking injunctive relief in court if necessary — to protect Maryland ratepayers.” Cox emphasized that his Public Information Act requests are intended to obtain clarity regarding what actions, if any, have been pursued by the Governor’s office and related agencies in response to rising electricity costs. “Transparency is the first step,” Cox said. “The people of Maryland deserve answers.” About Dan Cox Dan Cox is a candidate for Maryland Governor and an attorney and public advocate focused on government accountability, constitutional governance, and consumer protection for Maryland citizens. "As your Governor I won't delay, on day one I will act and order an immediate freeze of all electric rate increases since November 2025, order collections and fees to halt, and order the Governor's Energy Administration, the PSC, and the Office of the People's counsel to investigate and provide an immediate report and relief package for Marylanders including coordinating and taking any necessary legal action for emergency injunctive relief to stop the theft of our electricity ratepayers. "Governor Moore has complete control of a nearly $70 billion budget, and his $350 million dollar funded offices that oversee the skyrocketing electric bills are nearly silent except to blame foreign tariffs for rising costs of living, which is absurd considering the burden Wes Moore has caused with his inaction as electric bills skyrocket. "Marylanders are getting fleeced of their incomes by this out of touch administration while receiving Less with Wes Moore." Cox’s requests seek communications, internal discussions, enforcement actions, investigations, and any potential litigation strategies involving these utilities and PJM from November 1, 2025 to the present. “Marylanders are facing what many are describing as skyrocketing and in some cases quadrupling electric bills,” Cox said. “Taxpayers deserve to know what communications have occurred between Governor Moore’s administration and the utilities or PJM while families struggle to pay basic energy costs.” Cox noted that Governor Moore oversees a $68 billion state budget, including: • Approximately $8.3 million for the Office of People’s Counsel (OPC); • Approximately $30 million for the Public Service Commission (PSC); • Approximately $287 million for the Maryland Energy Administration; • Approximately $23 million for the Office of the Governor; Cox stated that, in his view, these agencies collectively represent roughly $350 million in taxpayer-funded operations that have not produced meaningful relief for Maryland ratepayers. Cox further pointed to reports that approximately $300 million from the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) ratepayer funds in the SEIF fund (Strategic Energy Investment Fund) was redirected by Gov. Moore to help balance the bloated state budget, rather than being used for energy cost mitigation. Cox stated that he is investigating the decision-making behind that allocation and its impact on electric bills. “I am investigating what I believe is unacceptable inaction,” Cox said. “Marylanders deserve transparency and immediate relief. I am calling on Governor Moore to issue executive orders directing his administration to take immediate action to reduce electric costs, and to pursue appropriate legal remedies — including seeking injunctive relief in court if necessary — to protect Maryland ratepayers.” Cox emphasized that his Public Information Act requests are intended to obtain clarity regarding what actions, if any, have been pursued by the Governor’s office and related agencies in response to rising electricity costs. “Transparency is the first step,” Cox said. “The people of Maryland deserve answers.” About Dan Cox Dan Cox is a candidate for Maryland Governor and an attorney and public advocate focused on government accountability, constitutional governance, and consumer protection for Maryland citizens. From **providing free assistance through the Black Immigrants Bail Fund** , to coordinating low- and no-cost legal representation and helping families navigate immigration courts, ABISA’s rapid response work is necessary—especially at this moment.
This week at the State of the Union, Trump specifically bragged about targeting Black immigrants, which ICE is doing in Minnesota, Maine, and beyond.
I spoke up against his racist lies and his dangerous expansion of law enforcement, an institution that’s already rooted in anti-Black racism.
**ABISA fights back. They challenge anti-Black and anti-immigrant rhetoric** , humanize immigrants and reframe migration as _resilience_ rather than _criminality_.
Immigration is not a crime, and ABISA pushes back against enforcement-first immigration policies, while**advocating for policies that protect and affirm the dignity of Black immigrants**.
Led by Black immigrant women who are directly impacted by ICE violence and are witnessing increased cruelty and terror, ABISA works toward transformative changes such as**ending immigration detention** , and convenes national response networks to detention crises.
ABISA **empowers newly arrived Black immigrants** —honoring their expertise while building the confidence, agency, and tools they need to fully participate in their communities.

This week at the State of the Union, Trump specifically bragged about targeting Black immigrants, which ICE is doing in Minnesota, Maine, and beyond. I spoke up against his racist lies and his dangerous expansion of law enforcement, an institution that’s already rooted in anti-Black racism. ABISA fights back. They challenge anti-Black and anti-immigrant rhetoric , humanize immigrants and reframe migration as resilience rather than criminality. Immigration is not a crime, and ABISA pushes back against enforcement-first immigration policies, whileadvocating for policies that protect and affirm the dignity of Black immigrants. Led by Black immigrant women who are directly impacted by ICE violence and are witnessing increased cruelty and terror, ABISA works toward transformative changes such asending immigration detention , and convenes national response networks to detention crises. ABISA empowers newly arrived Black immigrants —honoring their expertise while building the confidence, agency, and tools they need to fully participate in their communities. Thank you for standing with Black immigrants and demanding better for the people who call this country home. Dr. Sarr reminds us that we keep each other safe:"We must hold onto one another if we want to build a humanity we believe in—because it's not about me, it's about us, locked arm in arm." We get through together, we get free together, and we soar together. cadem.org [cadem.org]
On the 100th anniversary of Black History Month, we celebrate the richness of Black history—from trailblazers and inventors to artists, scientists, public servants and faith leaders alike.
California has been shaped by generations of Black leaders, organizers, activists, and everyday people who carry on the fight to deliver our country’s promise of justice and liberty for all. Black history is California history. We will continue to protect it, teach it, and honor it today and every day.
42 years ago, the late civil rights leader Reverend Jesse Jackson delivered his iconic "Rainbow Coalition" speech in San Francisco, and his words still inspire California Democrats today to rise up and organize.
Tune in to a special conversation with CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks and Secretary of State Dr. Shirley Weber as they remember Rev. Jesse Jackson's legacy:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r_sCrWqGIWA [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r_sCrWqGIWA]
Together, let's celebrate Black History and carry on the spirit of Reverend Jackson to “Keep hope alive!”

body:
This moment is a skill building moment for our movement.
#
**Last night, as part of the official launch of Alexandria’s 2026 re-election campaign, we hosted a Petition Kick-off Party in The Bronx.**
We trained and set up local organizers to go out into their community, talk with their neighbors and collect signatures to secure our place on the ballot.
**This moment is a skill building moment for our movement.** Eight years ago we learned the process of signature collection to get on the ballot.
Eight years later, we are still teaching and practicing this process with our volunteers because it’s essential that this knowledge lives in the community so no one can ever gatekeep access to the ballot again.
Our goal is simple: we want it so that anyone who is ever interested in running, or helping their neighbor run, can walk through these doors and learn the process for free.
Thank you for making this all possible and keeping this movement growing strong. Our campaign is truly grassroots — our average donation this month is just $16.
**A better world is possible**. And we’re here to demand it.
[ Will you donate $5 today? Every donation supports our organizers and will ensure we gather more than enough signatures to secure Alexandria’s place on the ballot this year.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260227.IJbS8d&refcode=em20260227-10869-P_FND_CTR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10869%2E2526796%2EuSU9MV)

No matter what, whether you can chip in today or not, thank you for being a part of this campaign.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Homes should belong to families, not hedge funds
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Wall Street landlords are buying up your town — here’s what we can do

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2799%2E4032634%2EA1_UDH)
---
Imagine working your whole life to buy a home — saving every paycheck, dreaming of the day you could finally turn the key — only to have your offer outbid by an algorithm backed by a billion-dollar balance sheet. At the same time, families who already bought their dream homes are facing a connected reality. They’ve built a life in their community and invested in their homes, but are also being priced out by the same corporate landlords. We are in a housing crisis. Our country is short of more than 7 million affordable homes. The median age of a first-time homebuyer is now 40. And yet, Wall Street investors are able to snap up single-family homes right and left like they’re financial instruments, not places where people live. **This isn't the housing market "doing its thing." It's consolidation. It's greed. It’s an intentional business model. And it's gutting the American Dream.** [**So I recently introduced the American Homeownership Act with my Democratic colleagues to get housing back into the hands of working people — not Wall Street executives. If you agree that we need proper safeguards to make sure Wall Street doesn’t price families out of the American Dream, add your name today.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AmHomeAct/?source=EMZ29X_HOU_E_20260227_V1S1&t=8&akid=2799%2E4032634%2EA1_UDH) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AmHomeAct/?source=EMZ29X_HOU_E_20260227_V1S1&t=9&akid=2799%2E4032634%2EA1_UDH)
---
Here's why this can't wait: Corporate landlords own nearly 450,000 single-family homes, more than 2.2 million apartments, and are the largest owners of mobile home communities in America.
In 2025 alone, they bought nearly 1 in every 6 homes sold — while first-time homebuyers hit an all-time low. In some neighborhoods, private equity owns a quarter of the homes on the block.
And when Wall Street moves in, families pay the price. Rents go up. Junk fees pile on. Maintenance gets ignored. Evictions spike. All while these firms pocket federal tax breaks and federally backed mortgages — subsidies funded by American taxpayers.
It just gets worse and worse.
Here’s what the **American Homeownership Act** will do:
* **End Wall Street's tax breaks.** Corporate landlords lose their housing deductions, federally backed mortgages, and access to foreclosed homes. Small landlords and builders keep their benefits. Corporate speculators don't.
* **Reinvest the savings in families.** Those billions go straight back into building more homes and helping working families buy them.
* **Break up housing monopolies.** We'll close the loopholes, letting corporations quietly corner local markets — and make any deal that controls more than 30% of a local market presumed illegal.

This housing crisis demands action from every angle. We need to build more homes. We need partnerships with local communities to cut red tape. And we need to stop allowing families from losing out on homes because some hedge fund manager can out-bid them and let the home sit empty.
[**If you agree that homes should belong to families — not hedge funds — add your name and show your support for the American Homeownership Act.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AmHomeAct/?source=EMZ29X_HOU_E_20260227_V1S1&t=10&akid=2799%2E4032634%2EA1_UDH)
[**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AmHomeAct/?source=EMZ29X_HOU_E_20260227_V1S1&t=11&akid=2799%2E4032634%2EA1_UDH)
---
Housing should be about building communities, not corporate portfolios. And I’m going to keep fighting to make sure that’s exactly what we do.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Peter,
**This week, Lt. Governor Aruna Miller and I officially filed to run for reelection.**
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/moore-20260227-endorse-wes/?source=em-20260227-1&t=2&akid=1234%2E1086043%2EIbuuxk)**

We’re cooperating across communities and across party lines to prove that there’s a better way forward. Thanks to the support of folks like you, we can prove that we can do better than just the politics of usual.
**[I would be honored to officially have your support as we begin our reelection campaign. Can I count on your endorsement?](https://act.wesmoore.com/signup/moore-20260227-endorse-wes/?source=em-20260227-1&t=4&akid=1234%2E1086043%2EIbuuxk)**

Elevate,

What’s more, the fair maps movement championed responsive measures like California’s Prop 50, which temporarily counteracts the Republican gerrymandering threat and protects the voting power of the American people. Keep scrolling to see what Stacey has to say at this pivotal moment.= In solidarity, The Fair Fight Team \------------------Forwarded Message------------------ From: Stacey Abrams Subject: A particularly grim and audacious salvo The Republican-led House of Representatives has launched a particularly grim and audacious salvo in the GOP’s all-out assault on our voting rights. They recently passed a mass voter suppression bill called the SAVE Act, which could disenfranchise tens of millions of Americans. And it’s part of a broader power grab to ensure the 2026 midterm elections are not free or fair. You see, a country can still hold elections on paper while becoming an autocracy in reality if the ruling regime is able to... 1\. Control elections. 2\. Decide who gets to vote. 3. Reject the results if they are politically inconvenient. Well, Donald Trump is calling on Republicans to “nationalize” elections. His party just advanced the SAVE Act — on top of a swarm of efforts across the country to restrict how voters can register, stay on the rolls, and cast their ballots. And by continuing to spread lies about 2020, including with the FBI raid on an elections office in Fulton County, Georgia, the Trump Regime is laying the groundwork to try to delegitimize future election losses. It’s chilling. It’s outrageous. But it’s also preventable — if we use all the tools at our disposal in our democracy while we still can. That’s why, today, I’m asking you to support an organization on the front lines of the fight for free and fair elections. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- This mission is urgent as the midterm election year kicks off in earnest. Trump and Republicans are returning to their favorite strategy for victory: voter suppression. So we must act fast to stop their power grabs. The MAGA GOP has launched an all-out assault on our voting rights because they are afraid to compete on a level playing field. They don’t know how to defend their record of ripping health care away from working families and handing massive tax breaks to billionaires. So instead of trying to persuade voters, they aim to suppress them. That includes the SAVE Act, which would require voters to present expensive and difficult-to-obtain government-issued documents to register to vote. Democracy must be a right, not a privilege for those who can afford it, and we must continue to protect that sacred principle. = Thank you, Stacey Abrams * = = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2026 Fair Fight - All rights reserved.
